62596.description: 107 Taste serves authentic, home-style Asian cuisine crafted by Chef Yu Bi. We specialize in traditional homemade dishes—noodles, dumplings, broths, and curries—made fresh daily with time-honored recipes. This is comfort food done right: genuine flavors, welcoming atmosphere, and the kind of Asian cooking that tastes like it came from a home kitchen, because that's exactly where these recipes come from. 107 Taste is a restaurant that brings the comforting flavors of home-cooked Asian cuisine with a creative twist. Inspired by the diverse culinary traditions of East Asia, Chef Yu Bi from Sichuan crafts each dish with passion, blending authentic recipes with bold innovations. Our specialties include sizzling hot wok noodles, rich and aromatic ramen slow brined for eight hours, and a variety of authentic bites that will delight your taste buds. Set in a beautifully designed space with chic, neutral décor, 107 Taste offers a warm and inviting atmosphere where every meal feels special.

62049.description: Located in the heart of Miami Lakes, 1910 Restaurant & Bar is a family-owned restaurant inspired by the elegance and glamour of the 1910 era, offering a unique international fusion of steakhouse, seafood, Italian, Cuban, Latin, and American cuisine. Known for its charcoal-grilled specialties, wood-fired pizzas, handmade pastas, premium steaks, and fresh seafood, 1910 has quickly become one of the area’s most celebrated dining destinations. Guests enjoy an upscale yet welcoming atmosphere featuring live violin and saxophone performances, soft live music, a full-service bar, elegant indoor dining, and a beautiful outdoor patio. With experienced chefs, exceptional hospitality, and a passion for culinary excellence, 1910 Restaurant & Bar delivers an unforgettable dining experience that embodies The Art of Dining.

2396.description: The 94th Aero Squadron Restaurant in Miami offers a distinctive dining experience that combines aviation history with a diverse menu. Overlooking the runway of Miami International Airport, guests can enjoy views of planes taking off and landing, with headphones available at each table to listen to live air traffic control communications. The restaurant's design emulates a World War I-era French farmhouse, complete with vintage military memorabilia, providing a unique and immersive atmosphere. The menu features a variety of American and international dishes, including steakhouse classics, seafood, and pasta. The restaurant also offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and happy hour services.

3116.description: Located in the historic Art Deco District, A Fish Called Avalon specializes in seafood with tropical influences. Enjoy your meal in our beautiful dining room, which has floor to ceiling windows with views of world-famous Ocean Drive. Dine on our terrace, where live music and ocean breezes set a sophisticated and authentic South Beach experience. The dinner menu includes a raw bar, as well as macadamia-crusted snapper and an orzo seafood paella among many other seafood bestsellers. Other non-seafood options include ribeye, vegetarian pasta, and a free-range citrus chicken. There is a full bar and an award-winning wine list. Dinner Hours: 5:00 - to 10:30 pm Mon-Wed & 5:00 - to 11:00 pm Thu-Sun Happy Hour: 3:00 to 7:00 pm Daily Enjoy luscious libations and a selection of some signature appetizers at the bar, seven days a week from 3:00 to 7:00 p.m. Live music daily. Reservations are highly suggested. Culinary excellence Since 1989. Public parking garage located on 7th Street between Washington and Collins Avenue. Valet Parking Option - 3 hours for $10.

61828.description: Amazónico Miami brings the pulse of Latin America to the heart of Brickell with a three-story dining and nightlife experience designed to transport guests into a world of tropical glamour, elevated cuisine, and nonstop energy. Inspired by the richness of the Amazon rainforest and the vibrant spirit of 1970s Rio de Janeiro, Amazónico blends immersive design, world-class hospitality, and globally influenced Latin American flavors into one of Miami’s most sought-after destinations. From the moment guests arrive, they are surrounded by lush greenery, woven textures, volcanic stone, dramatic lighting, and curated music that evolves throughout the night. The ground-floor restaurant offers an open-kitchen concept where diners can experience the theater of live-fire cooking, fresh seafood, premium meats, and vibrant Amazon-inspired dishes while live jazz, bossa nova, and Cuban rhythms create an unforgettable atmosphere. Upstairs, the Bar & Lounge transforms the experience into a high-energy social escape, featuring a signature sushi counter, expertly crafted tropical cocktails, mirrored ceilings, and resident DJs alongside live percussion performances. Every detail is designed to blur the line between fine dining and nightlife, making Amazónico equally ideal for intimate dinners, celebratory evenings, and late-night experiences. Crowning the venue is its iconic rooftop, an open-air destination that captures the electric spirit of Miami after dark. With skyline views, a dramatic peacock-inspired bar, immersive lighting, and a music-driven ambiance, the rooftop delivers an effortlessly sophisticated setting for cocktails, private events, and unforgettable nights in Brickell. As the first U.S. location of the internationally acclaimed Amazónico brand — with celebrated venues in Madrid, London, Dubai, and Monte Carlo — Amazónico Miami has quickly established itself as a premier destination where luxury dining, entertainment, and culture converge under one roof.

14579.description: Aromas del Peru is a culinary landmark with multiple locations across Miami, proudly known as one of the pioneers of traditional Peruvian cuisine in the city. Rooted in the rich heritage of Peru’s Costa, Sierra, and Selva regions, we have passionately introduced the flavors of our homeland to the world—celebrating the depth of our culinary traditions while embracing creative innovation. Our menu honors the authentic Creole classics that define Peruvian comfort food, while also showcasing a modern fusion of cultures that have shaped our gastronomy—Andean, African, Chinese, Japanese, and European influences come together in bold, flavorful, and beautifully crafted dishes. At Aromas, we believe that food is a cultural experience. That’s why we take pride in using high-quality ingredients, traditional techniques, and heartfelt hospitality to offer every guest a taste of Peru’s culinary soul. Whether you're enjoying a beloved traditional plate or one of our elevated signature creations, every dish tells a story—of our roots, our people, and our evolution. Come experience Aromas del Peru, where tradition meets innovation, and every meal feels like coming home.

13517.description: Standing out in the sea of critically-acclaimed restaurants and bars that call Miami Beach home is no small task, but Azabu Miami Beach manages to do exactly that. A Unique Dining Experience in the Heart of Miami Beach The first thing to know about Azabu Miami Beach is that it’s unlike any other restaurant or bar in the city, offering a spectrum of experiences under a single, stylish roof. There are three separate but connected spaces within the venue, each one united by incredible food, drinks, and service. First is the full-service dining room, where diners can take a front-row seat to the chefs’ culinary prowess thanks to the large, open kitchen. Just steps beyond the dining room is The Den , a hidden gem where Tokyo-trained sushi chefs craft some of the best sashimi and sushi in Miami . Finally, Bar Azabu is the venue’s classic cocktail bar, serving the best sakes in the world and more than 40 different imported whiskeys. Azabu Miami Beach also hosts private events and provides off-site catering , going above and beyond to deliver on their signature omotenashi promise.

62644.description: Located in the heart of Brickell, B Bistro + Bakery is a vibrant urban oasis from Chef Henry Hané, offering globally inspired cuisine alongside an impressive selection of freshly baked pastries and desserts. Drawing from Chef Hané's international culinary experience, the menu brings together creative flavors and techniques in a relaxed, contemporary setting. Start the day with freshly baked croissants, Danish and brioche, or explore a menu of inventive breakfast, brunch and lunch favorites. Signature dishes range from Pastelito Pancakes and Croissant Loaf French Toast to Steak & Eggs, Lump Crab Eggs Benedict, fresh salads, sandwiches and house specialties. The bakery also tempts with macarons, cakes, tarts and other handcrafted sweets. Open daily for breakfast, brunch and lunch, B Bistro + Bakery offers indoor dining and a pet-friendly patio, making it a convenient stop for a leisurely meal while exploring Brickell.

60141.description: At Bagatelle Miami River, the spirit of the French Riviera comes alive through a blend of sophistication and playful elegance. Inspired by St. Tropez, the waterfront space is filled with natural light, lush greenery, and curated French details, from artwork to cabanas, creating a transportive escape along the Miami River. Bagatelle comes to life from day into night with refined dinner service, lively evenings, and the iconic Bagatelle Sundays, featuring a rotating DJ lineup that sets the tone for an elevated brunch-to-party experience. Wednesday - Saturday, as the sun begins to set, guests are invited to discover Sunset Offerings along the river. Sunset Hour is a relaxed early-evening ritual at the outdoor bar, featuring $2 oysters, seafood bites, champagne by the glass, and signature cocktails. For those seeking a seated dining experience, Sunset Dinner offers a three-course pre-fixe menu of signature favorites with optional wine pairings. Whether dining indoors, enjoying al fresco river views, or gathering for brunch and late-night energy, Bagatelle Miami River delivers a vibrant, ever-evolving experience that captures Miami’s global spirit with the charm of the South of France. Dinner: Wednesday & Thursday | 6pm - 1:30am Friday & Saturday | 6pm - 2:30am Sunset Hour - Happy Hour Menu: Wednesday - Saturday | 6pm - 7:30pm Bagatelle Sunday Brunch Sunday | 12pm - 10:30pm

24161.description: Baia Beach Club brings the laid-back spirit and effortless sophistication of Mediterranean coastal living to the new Mondrian South Beach, an icon reborn. Baia Beach Club culls together elevated, authentic Food and Beverage offerings, progressive Health and Wellness services and immersive social activities to create a truly modern oasis of taste and tranquility in the heart of South Beach. Within the lush tropical centerpiece of a multi-million-dollar property-wide transformation, club members can indulge in the naturally seamless blend of indoor and outdoor space, public and private areas, recreational and restorative facilities and day and night activity for a truly singular experience that is as chic as it is casual that you’ll enjoy from the early morning late into the night. 13831.description: BALEENkitchen at Solé Miami offers a journey through global cuisines. We are inspired by our namesake, the Baleen whale, known for traveling the world's waters from the Arctic to the tropics, and everywhere in between. BALEENkitchen brings this nomadic lifestyle to the table with a menu that celebrates the flavors of the world. Our enviable location overlooking the Atlantic Ocean and our warm Miami-chic design creates magical memories loved by locals and visitors alike. Guests enjoy arriving early for small plates and an array of unique cocktails curated by our tenured bartenders. Dining Hours: Breakfast BALEENkitchen Daily 8:00 am – 11:00 am Lunch Tipsy Turtle Pool Bar & Lounge or BALEENkitchen Daily 11:30 am – 4:30 pm Dinner BALEENkitchen Daily 5:00 pm – 10:00 pm *Ask about nightly chef crafted specials BALEEN Crafted Happy Hour Daily 5:00 pm – 7:00 pm Join us for Happy Hour specials and a small plates menu. Select Margaritas $8 Select Martinis $8 House wines $8 Imported beers $6 Domestic beers $5 Private Dining The Perfect Setting for your Private Oceanfront Event Bold flavors, creative mixology, chic surroundings and gracious service create a magical ambiance for your next intimate gathering or group event at the beach. Allow us to create a customized menu and signature cocktails as we personalize your celebration to create lasting memories. For larger groups and a more extravagant affair, partial to full restaurant buyouts are available.

4558.description: Barsecco is a stylish restaurant & lounge that transforms from bright and open to sensual and inviting by night. Enter just off Brickell Avenue onto the breezy canopied terrace where eclectic seating, draping vines and reclaimed barn wood welcome guests to mingle, dine and relax. Inside, plush interiors, towering tree and low lighting lend a seductive edge to an otherwise cozy space. As lights dim and cocktails are poured, a warm, social dining experience is encouraged with shared-plates drawn from diverse cultures and a local twist. Here, classic & creative cocktails highlight fresh ingredients, along with beers, bottle service, and an international selection of spirits, wine and champagne. In the later hours, programming infuses energy to ensure the mood is right for a convivial night fueled by cocktails, music and late-night bites. Canta Corazón Barsecco is turning up the volume with the debut of Canta Corazón, a new interactive nightlife experience launching April 16, 2026, in Brickell. Designed for big energy and crowd participation, Canta Corazón puts guests in the middle of the action with sing-along moments, live DJ sets, and a soundtrack packed with Latin favorites and iconic English hits. Happening Thursday through Saturday nights , the new concept is made for birthdays, group nights out, and unforgettable celebrations, with signature food, drinks, and surprise moments that keep the party going. Reservations are available via OpenTable. For updates and event content, follow: @barsecco and @cantacorazon.miami

47533.description: Welcome to Bayshore Club - built on the historic site known as Dinner Key and part of Miami's oldest neighborhood, Coconut Grove. Originally an island and later connected to the mainland in 1914, Dinner Key received its name for being a beautiful picnic stop while traveling by boat along the coastal waters of the city. In 1918 it became the site of the first continental naval air station in the United States until the end of WWI. Through the 1930’s and 40’s, Dinner Key served as a base for Pan American World Airway’s flying boats, the Sikorsky S41 and S42 (commonly known as Clipper planes). The planes were once housed in the newly restored hangers at Bayshore Club and the original Art Deco airport terminal is now the site Miami City Hall located to the southeast side of the restaurant.

47528.description: Beauty and the Butcher, in Coral Gables. Ford, who earned a Michelin star for the critically-acclaimed restaurant Stubborn Seed, will showcase his culinary prowess at Beauty and the Butcher with a menu that will focus on rotating seasonal small plates and a selection of different meats. Beauty and the Butcher is a nod to Ford's relationship with his eldest daughter, Madelynn (the beauty), and himself (the butcher). For more information follow @beautyandthebutchermiami. Beauty & the Butcher features an expansive modern dining room with seating for 160, including 30 seats at the bar, and blends contemporary decor with the comforts of home. A smooth gray-veined quartz bar anchors the space and wraps around a display of dry-aging meats. Warm earth-toned woods and glittering bronze accents are found throughout and tabletops and dining chairs alternate between white quartz, honey and caramel hues. Cozy booths are upholstered in forest green leather and are juxtaposed with artfully-decorated bookshelves. Soft lighting from the room’s brass-toned chandeliers emit an inviting glow that runs through the floor-to-ceiling windows out onto the street corner. Tucked away at the back of the restaurant, a private dining room with seating for up to 30 sitting or 60 cocktail-style allows for intimate private events. The exterior of the restaurant features natural elements including red oak wood and limestone, with bronze metal framing the corner entrance to the restaurant.

62090.description: Bella celebrates the unfiltered joy, strength, and warmth of Southern Italy. Inspired by Chef Eyal Shani’s admiration for the region, its culture, its women, its markets, its elemental flavors, Bella expresses Italian tradition through a Mediterranean point of view. Bella is both a character and a culinary philosophy. She’s the Italian woman who has been stirring pots, rolling pasta, and feeding people her entire life. Warm. Confident. Vibrant. Her spirit shapes the food, the atmosphere, and the way guests are welcomed. At Liberty Park Hotel, Bella becomes something new: Italian warmth, Mediterranean craft, and Miami Beach electricity served under sunlight and starlight.

2342.description: Welcome to Bistro Collins The distinctive new culinary centerpiece of Loews Miami Beach Hotel - a stylish dining destination that exemplifies American coastal bistro cuisine. Inspired by the inviting spirit of bistro culture, here timeless technique blends with the vibrant, locally-driven flavors of Latin America and the Caribbean. The result is an elevated take on beloved classics, alongside fresh, inspired dishes destined to become new favorites. Classic Roots. Coastal Soul. At Bistro Collins, we celebrate the balance of simplicity and creativity. Where thoughtful sourcing, seasonal ingredients and culinary craftsmanship come together on every plate. Dishes like Croque Madame Fritters, classic Steak Tartare and delicate handmade pastas share the table with Roasted Prawns with aji panca, Braised Beef Empanadas and bright island-inspired salads. Refined yet approachable, familiar yet unexpected, our menu pays homage to tradition while embracing the colorful flavors that define Miami’s culinary landscape. Complementing our American coastal bistro cuisine is an imaginative cocktail program, featuring artful mixology that celebrates globally inspired spirits. Whether beginning your stay, indulging in a leisurely evening or soaking in the energy of South Beach, Bistro Collins invites you to savor a dining experience that feels refined, relaxed and undeniably Miami.

It is a secret place, exclusive, but unpretentious, minimal decoration, where the food is the star. A sophisticated Japanese cuisine experience but with a modern interpretation, with a quality-driven menu curated to activate your senses and focusing on the food. Blind Tiger is the reimagination of a traditional sushi from traditional nigiri, sashimi or maki to more adventurous sushi combinations. No matter their menu choices, all guests of Blind Tiger can indulge in a high-quality Japanese experience.

The Mediterranean-style exterior with a beautiful central courtyard encompasses the restaurant, designed by long-time Bouchon collaborator Adam D. Tihany of Tihany Design in New York City, who worked on both Bouchon restaurants in Yountville and Las Vegas. It also includes the signature raw bar, featuring a selection of fruits de mer, complemented by an extensive French and domestic wine list, along with traditional cocktails.

972.description: Boulud Sud is Chef Daniel Boulud’s vibrant celebration of the sun and the sea. Drawing inspiration from the coastal Mediterranean, including France’s Côte d’Azur, Spain, Italy, Greece, Morocco, Tunisia, Lebanon, Israel, and Turkey the menu emphasizes regional flavors, featuring an abundance of fresh vegetables, seafood, grains and herbs. The restaurant has been completely renovated in jewel tones and soft fabrics to create a relaxing and casual atmosphere. Boulud Sud also boasts an exceptional cocktail program that actively pulls from the same seasonal products found on the food menu and Our bar/lounge serves food continuously from noon and features a happy hour from 5 to 8pm (excluding weekends). Situated in the JW Marriott Marquis and across the street from the newly opened Silverspot Theatres, Boulud Sud is conveniently located within walking distance of American Airlines Arena, the Perez Art Museum, Brickell City Centre, and all that Downtown Miami has to offer.

63081.description: Brooklyn Chop House is where the bold flavors of an Asian kitchen meet the timeless appeal of a classic American steakhouse. Located in the heart of New York City's Financial District and Times Square and now in Wynwood, Miami, the restaurant delivers an elevated dining experience fueled by exceptional cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, and an electric atmosphere. Owned by renowned hip-hop entrepreneur Robert "Don Pooh" Cummins and partner David Thomas, with culinary management led by Stratis Morfogen, Brooklyn Chop House seamlessly blends food, music, and culture into one unforgettable destination. The menu features premium steaks, innovative Asian-inspired dishes, and the brand's signature dumplings, creating a dining experience that is both familiar and unexpected. Curated music, vibrant energy, and stylish surroundings set the stage for everything from business dinners to lively nights out. At Brooklyn Chop House, every visit is more than a meal—it's an experience where great food, exceptional drinks, and New York City's unmistakable culture come together. Come see us in Wynwood!

23005.description: Bulla Gastrobar is a lively and modern Spanish restaurant that brings the spirit of a traditional tapas bar to life. Inspired by the energy of Spanish street-side cafés and the joy of shared dining, Bulla offers a menu filled with vibrant, handcrafted tapas, paellas, and seasonal specialties made for gathering and connecting. Each dish is rooted in authentic Spanish flavors and crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients, encouraging guests to experience a little bit of everything. More than just a meal, dining at Bulla is a social experience. The atmosphere is warm and energetic, with an open kitchen and bustling bar that set the stage for spontaneous conversation and culinary discover. It's the perfect place to eat, drink, and share in the true spirit of Spanish hospitality.

47543.description: A tribute to Cuba and its Cultural influences. Calle Dragones, already a success in Bogota and Cartagena (Colombia), resembles the street in Havana that bears its name and collides with Calle Zanja, dividing the Chinese neighborhood from the rest of Havana. Originally invented by Chinese migrants brought to Cuba as laborers in the 1850's, Asian Latin cuisine blended Chinese and Caribbean ingredients and cooking techniques. The Cuban Revolution in 1959, however, got in the way and deprived the world to meet what was meant to be today's Cuban cuisine. Many left the island and concentrated in Miami and New York. Havana's Chinatown is still one of the oldest and largest in the Americas.

Campo celebrates the bounty of the land, crafting health-conscious dishes from locally sourced ingredients. Here, every meal tells a story, blending farm-to-table freshness with a soulful Latin touch. Campo serves breakfast, brunch, and dinner daily, featuring everything from refreshing smoothies and garden-fresh salads to hearty, nourishing entrées. Whether starting your day or indulging in a sumptuous dinner, Campo invites you to experience a feast that nourishes both body and soul.

24507.description: With more than two decades of experience in the Miami culinary scene, Executive Chef and Owner Mariano Araya launched Casa Mariano, early-Summer 2021 in Doral. Here, Chef Araya shares his personal style of cuisine with a menu representing the culmination of an impressive career, drawing inspiration from his most loved dishes. The upscale, yet approachable concept reflects Chef Mariano’s sensibility with a Mediterranean-inspired menu complemented by a globally sourced wine program. Decorated in rich hues of blues, whites and corals, Casa Mariano’s 1475 square-foot interiors create an elegant, warm, and inviting environment – an intentional design to transport diners as if they are being welcomed into Araya’s own casa. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating and serves breakfast, lunch and dinner.

54253.description: Casadonna is a coastal Italian-inspired waterfront restaurant developed in partnership between Groot Hospitality and Tao Group Hospitality. It is housed in the same Mediterranean Revival building as Miami’s historic women’s club, located in the city’s burgeoning Edgewater neighborhood. In fact, the name “Casadonna” is derived from the setting-it is a fusion of Italian words translating to “house of the woman" Riviera-style Italian cooking serves as the heart of Casadonna’s cuisine. The menu features the freshest and finest local and imported products, with signature handcrafted dishes. Plates are based around traditional recipes found in the coastal towns of Naples, Taormina, Bari, Positano, and Gaeta, and each is presented in a contemporary fashion. Bespoke cocktails and an extensive wine list will complement this approach

60115.description: Cave 305 is a stylish all-day dining destination in the heart of Miami Beach, offering a polished yet welcoming atmosphere just steps from the sand. Travelers can start their morning with a relaxed breakfast or brunch and return later in the day for bold, flavor-forward plates that highlight premium steaks, fresh seafood, and elevated comfort classics. As the day winds down, the restaurant shifts into a vibrant dinner setting with generous cuts grilled to perfection and a full bar that stays open until 2 a.m. It’s an ideal spot for a date night, a celebratory meal with friends, or a leisurely evening after exploring South Beach. With its modern design, warm hospitality, and convenient Collins Avenue location, Cave 305 delivers a memorable dining experience for any leisure traveler looking to indulge.

5176.description: Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar: Miami's Taste of Tradition & Twist Born in 1926 inside The Watson Hotel, Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar has always mirrored Miami's pulse. What beg, n as a tropical hideaway grew bolder in 1959, when Cuban newcomers infused the city-and our kitchen-with their rich culinary heritage. Today, this cool, modern spot is the city's go-to place to socialize, grab a craft drink, and indulge ir delicious Cuban-fusion plates. Led by next-gen chefs who blend abuela's secrets with global flair, every bite tells a story-whether it's our award-winning Cuban Sandwich, Yucca-Stuffed Shrimp, or sky-high Pan con Bistec. At the bar, Havana beats on: mojitos bursting with fresh-picked fruit, Floridita-style daiquiris, and the smoky Caballero Old Fashioned keep the fiesta flowing from lunch to late night. History, innovation, community-served hot and shaken cold. Welcome home to Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar, whe e Miami's past meets its delicious, social future.

The cocktail program, created with Unfiltered Hospitality, is designed to spark curiosity and keep things interesting from the first sip to the last round. And then there’s our monkey mascot. Playful, a little mischievous, and exactly the kind of energy you’ll feel the moment you walk in. CHO leans into the edginess of South Beach. It’s moody, a little sexy, always upbeat. This is where quality ingredients go out to have fun!

26294.description: Since February 2021, the Miami outpost of Michelin-starred and James Beard Award nominated Korean Steakhouse COTE NYC has been serving elevated Korean cuisine in Miami’s Design District. The 5,892-square-foot restaurant combines the bold flavors of Korean barbecue with the classic vibe of an American steakhouse. The result is a fine dining experience featuring top-notch service, world-class ingredients and a show-stopping beverage program. Helmed by executive chef David Shim, COTE’s signature menu items include 45-day, USDA prime dry-aged beef with nutrient-dense, probiotic-rich side dishes; a Butcher’s Feast with chef’s choice of four selected cuts of meat accompanied by an assortment of Korean side dishes; and an elevated Steak Omakase experience. The sleek, intimate, 100+ seat dining area features smokeless state-of-the-art tabletop grills at every table. There is also an elaborate dry-aging room and two private dining rooms. COTE’s 1200+ label wine list was nominated for “Outstanding Wine Program” two consecutive years in a row by the James Beard Foundation and also awarded Florida Sommelier. Other notable awards include the 2022 MICHELIN Guide Florida Star Revelation which recognizes the COTE brand as one of the only two restaurants in the United States with MICHELIN stars in multiple cities.

16773.description: A sister restaurant to the MICHELIN Guide-recommended Daniel’s, A Florida Steakhouse in Fort Lauderdale, Daniel’s Miami brings GIOIA Hospitality’s signature blend of exceptional cuisine, world-class wine, and refined hospitality to one of South Florida’s most iconic destinations. The menu showcases an elevated steak program featuring premium cuts sourced from renowned producers around the world, complemented by fresh local seafood, classic Italian specialties, and thoughtfully crafted selections for vegetarians and seafood enthusiasts alike. Led by GIOIA Hospitality Founder and CEO Tom Angelo, Managing Director Kassidy Angelo, Culinary Director Danny Ganem, Executive Chef Dayam Lopez, and Wine & Beverage Director Daniel Bishop, the restaurant delivers an exceptional dining experience rooted in European-style hospitality, attention to detail, and personalized service. Guests seeking a more relaxed experience can enjoy the dedicated Daniel’s Bar menu, offering signature dishes, cocktails, and wines in an inviting lounge setting enhanced with televisions and comfortable seating. The space features iconic artwork and sophisticated design elements that create an atmosphere both elegant and welcoming. In addition, guests can look forward to Daniel’s award-winning wine program and celebrated wine dinners, signature experiences that have become hallmarks of the GIOIA Hospitality name.

53695.description: Delilah Miami is a modern-day supper club that brings a vibrant flair to the heart of Brickell. Elegantly situated with a yacht slip on the waterfront, allure and timeless charm become one at Delilah. This vintage-inspired sanctuary immerses guests in Miami’s sultry spirit set aglow by lavish chandeliers that cast a warm glow upon its plush interior. Within this haven, guests are enveloped in nostalgia by the gentle crackling of the fireplace and the embrace of overstuffed armchairs, elevating comfort while indulging on exquisite American fare. Dining elevates to dancing as a troupe of female entertainers move to the sounds of a live jazz band. Eating, drinking, and dancing blur while guests relish in lounge-style bottle service deep into the rhythm of the night…oh yeah.

27103.description: DOYA is a modern Aegean Meze + Bar restaurant, located in the heart of Wynwood. Inspired by the Grecian and Turkish Meze culture, DOYA embraces the principle that food tastes better when shared with people you love. Doya's meat and vegetable dishes are prepared over wood fire and coals with flavors from the greater Mediterranean region and the Middle East. Recently awarded a Michelin Bob Gourmand, DOYA's menu features a flavorful selection of cold and hot meze dishes prepared from ingredients that are seasonal and of the highest quality. Doya is open 7 days a week serving lunch and dinner. Guests have the option of dining indoors where the restaurant's extensive bar is located or outdoor in the lush, garden area.

62733.description: Located in the heart of Coconut Grove, Drinking Pig BBQ puts a Miami spin on classic American barbecue with a menu that blends slow-smoked Southern traditions and bold Caribbean flavors. Founded by Chef Raheem Sealey, the restaurant began as a popular pop-up before becoming a neighborhood favorite known for expertly smoked brisket, ribs, pulled pork and house-made sausages, paired with creative island-inspired sides and award-winning sauces. The casual, walk-in-only smokehouse offers a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike, making it a great stop for lunch or dinner after exploring Coconut Grove. Whether you're craving tender smoked meats, comforting barbecue classics or a uniquely Miami take on traditional BBQ, Drinking Pig BBQ delivers an unforgettable dining experience.

17604.description: Located in Miami's vibrant Wynwood neighborhood, dōma Wynwood offers an elevated take on modern Italian cuisine in an artistic setting. Helmed by Chef Davide Porcaccio, the kitchen celebrates authentic flavors with a contemporary edge—crafting standout dishes like Tagliolini al Tartufo Nero, sea salt–crusted Branzino served tableside, and house-made Pistachio Gelato. The ambiance is chic and elegant, blending refined design with Wynwood's creative energy. Perfect for date nights, special occasions, or simply indulging your love for Italian food and fine wine, dōma provides a warm, upscale experience. Wine lovers will appreciate the curated list of Italian and global vintages, thoughtfully paired with each dish. Signature cocktails—like the velvety espresso martini—add a stylish finish. Whether dining inside among modern art or relaxing on the serene patio, dōma delivers unforgettable cuisine and exceptional service in Miami.

4816.description: Located in South Beach’s South of Fifth neighborhood, Estiatorio Milos is renowned for excellent fish and seafood and a refined approach to Greek cuisine. The fresh seafood selection is shipped daily from the Mediterranean. The menu offerings include Greek ceviche, grilled octopus, and Greek favorites like skordalia, grilled vegetables, and hummus. If you’re not in the mood for seafood, there are other options like ribeye, filet mignon and lamb. Impeccable service, convivial family-style sharing and exciting tableside food preparation provide an unforgettable and truly exceptional dining experience. For reservations, call the restaurant directly at (305) 604-6800. Lunch is served daily from 12 pm to 3 pm. Dinner is served Sunday to Thursday from 5:30 - 10 p.m., and Friday - Saturday from 5:30 - 10:30 p.m. Visit estiatoriomilos.com for menus and more information.

13139.description: Your Brickell Fleming's is located at Brickell World Plaza just one block away from Brickell City Centre. Fleming's in Brickell is an outstanding choice to enjoy an exceptional Prime steak, glass of wine or handcrafted cocktail in Miami. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, hosting a business lunch or dinner or simply wanting to enjoy a night out — we will create a memorable experience for you in our Dining Room. If you prefer to enjoy your fine dining experience at home, you can order and pay for lunch or dinner online for carry out or select from one of our delivery partners. Our new Weekday Lunch Menu features a flavorful range of sandwiches, salads and more for the perfect mid-day break from the office or a chance to catch-up with friends. Our Dinner Menu has something to offer everyone in your party from seven different steak cuts to best-in-class seafood and plant-based options. Looking to host a private event or business meeting in our restaurant or at a different location? Our Events & Catering Menu offers a wide selection of hors d'oeuvres, starters, multi-course lunches and dinners as well as wine and beverage selections. For private dining events hosted in restaurant, our Events & Catering Associate will help you select one of our private dining rooms to accommodate your Guest list and coordinate all the details to ensure it’s a perfect occasion.

1195.description: This authentic Brazilian Steakhouse (Churrascaria) has been setting the standard in Brazil for the past 35 years. The menu includes delectable cuts of fire-roasted meats such as sizzling steaks, lamb, chicken and pork carved tableside by Brazilian trained gaucho chefs that prepare and cook each cut. Meat is not the only offering of this Brazilian eatery, as you can also enjoy a gourmet salad and sides bar consisting of salads, fresh-cut vegetables, cured meats, smoked salmon and imported cheeses, as well as a variety of traditional Brazilian side dishes such as world-famous such as pao de queijo (warm cheese bread).To enhance your dining experience, enjoy a glass of wine from the award-winning wine list.

3560.description: Fontana offers Italian-inspired cuisine punctuated with local and seasonal ingredients and an exceptional wine list. The handsome rusticity of the restaurant’s stone and tile interior, with an open-air kitchen and wood-burning stove, flows into the lush landscaping of the fountain-centered courtyard, the site of Miami’s most romantic outdoor dining. Fontana mounts one of the country’s most celebrated and lavish Sunday Champagne Brunch buffets. Utilizing the restaurant’s handsome interior and courtyard, the brunch features an extensive array of selections, including omelet, sushi, carving, pasta and tapas stations, plus decadent desserts. Open Monday through Saturday from 7 to 11:00 a.m. (breakfast), 11:30 a.m. to 3 p.m. (lunch), and 6 to 10:00 p.m. (dinner). Open on Sundays from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. (brunch) and 6:00 to 10:00 p.m. (dinner). Seats up to 225 inside and out.

19269.description: Ghee Indian Kitchen redefined Indian dining in South Florida when it opened in Miami’s Dadeland neighborhood and went on to earn MICHELIN Bib Gourmand Awards in 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025. The restaurant strives to incorporate fresh produce from Chef Niven’s Rancho Patel and has become renowned for its welcoming hospitality and high-energy dining. It enchants both South Asian guests, who seek the authentic flavors of home, as well as locals and visitors seeking a bit of a culinary adventure. Ghee Indian Kitchen puts seasonal and contemporary spins on traditional fare. Ghee means “pure” and has a symbolic meaning both spiritually and in the kitchen of an Indian home. Ingredient driven using local artisan purveyors, the restaurant encompasses traditional Indian home cooking.

5581.description: Gyu-Kaku, meaning “Horn of the Bull” in Japanese, provides the authentic Japanese yakiniku (grilled barbecue) dining experience where customers share premium cooked meats over a flaming grill, while sipping on Japanese sake, shochu, and frosty cold beers. We offer a wide variety small plate dishes and appetizers in addition to barbecue meats such as our best-seller Harami Skirt Steak in Miso Marinade and Prime Kalbi Short Ribs in Tare Sweet Soy Marinade. You can't help it - with a personal grill installed at every table, everyone instantly becomes an expert cook. Spending time with friends and family is what Gyu-Kaku is all about. The sounds around you are of parties and laughter - the PERFECT choice for first dates, family occasions, and catching up with friends.

12863.description: Located on Ocean Drive, Havana 1957 creates a unique dining experience that allows you relive the glory and glamour of Old Cuba during the 1950s. The menu offers a variety of Cuban favorites, like croquetas, media noche sandwich, picadillo and grilled grouper. Wash it down with a traditional mojito, and finish everything off with a shot of Cuban espresso. Make your reservation online or call 305-515-0723 Hours are Sunday to Thursday from 9 a.m. to 1 a.m., Friday and Saturday till 2 a.m. This restaurant also serves breakfast . Check out our website to learn about special holiday menus, like the New Year’s Eve Gala .

61223.description: Ichimi Ramen & Bar is a Japanese ramen restaurant located in Midtown Miami, dedicated to authentic craftsmanship and bold, refined flavors. Our signature broths are carefully slow-simmered for 18 hours using natural chicken and pork bones to achieve depth and richness, complemented by hand-crafted noodles made from our exclusive recipe. At Ichimi, we blend traditional Japanese culinary techniques with a warm, welcoming atmosphere to create a memorable dining experience for locals and visitors alike. We proudly serve the Miami community with high-quality ingredients, attentive hospitality, and a genuine passion for sharing the art and culture of Japanese ramen.

60923.description: Jacinta de México is a soulful tribute to the strength of Mexican women and the ancestral culinary traditions rooted in their homes and communities. That vision comes to life through an uncompromising commitment to authenticity, including the use of nixtamalization, a 4,000-year-old Aztec process used to craft hand-pressed tortillas from organic criollo corn each day. Set within a vibrant, Tulum-inspired space filled with natural wood and greenery, Jacinta invites guests to explore a menu that spans time and tradition, from celebrated delicacies to botanical-forward cocktails, offering a chance to experience Mexican history one flavorful bite at a time. Jacinta de México is located at 19501 Biscayne Blvd. in Aventura Mall near Bloomingdale’s. For more information, visit https://jacintarestaurant.com/.

513.description: At Jaguar, the spirit of the revered jungle cat comes alive through bold flavors, vibrant hospitality, and a deep connection to Latin America. From chef-curated lunches and weekend brunch to Hora Jaguar, handcrafted cocktails, and customizable dining experiences, every dish is crafted with intention to celebrate the diversity and warmth of Latin American culture. More than a restaurant, Jaguar is a place where authentic food, genuine hospitality, and meaningful moments bring people together, proudly sharing our roots with Miami's diverse community and guests from around the world.

Metered street parking and valet are available.

3113.description: Before the glitz and glamour that has become "SoBe," Joe's Stone Crab Restaurant stood as a spot for true seafood-loving locals and tourists alike. Established in 1913, two years before Miami Beach would even become incorporated, Joe’s has withstood the test of time. Opened as "Joe's Restaurant" by Joe and Jennie Weiss, local seafood was served up on their front porch after being prepared in their kitchen. Move forward to 1920, when a Harvard ichthyologist brought an unknown crustacean to Joe’s. Joe threw the crab into boiling water and, voila! Stone crabs were discovered. They have dominated not only the menu at Joe’s Stone Crab , but have been a Miami staple ever since. Fast-forward more than 100 years and Joe's has held its place as the leader in stone crabs, fresh seafood and, since its partnership with a Florida cattle ranch, outstanding steaks. From the moment you approach the grandeur of the restaurant (it sits on the corner of South Pointe Drive and Washington Avenue, enveloping most of the block), you can see the attention to detail that is prevalent in the atmosphere, which leads to the incredible dining experience you'll enjoy. A lush and peaceful outside patio greets you. If you’d like to stay outside you can relax on Joe's patio, where the full menu is served. A Seafood Dining Adventure As you enter, a hand-carved mahogany bar beckons. Rich brass details accent the dark wood and terrazzo floors that extend into the entire restaurant. Enjoy a hand-crafted cocktail (Key lime martini anyone?) and a bite from the bar menu available any time after 2:30 p.m. Comfy and cozy leather booths adorn one side of the bar and are available for daytime lunch dates or drinks and appetizers during dinner. Whatever you choose, attentive bartenders and cocktail servers are there to help you decide. Joe's prides itself on its outstanding service and this is proven with its staff, some with more than 30 years of experience. If a more formal dining experience is what you're looking for, head to the maître d' stand and get seated in one of the three dining rooms. If you want to be transported back to the early days of Joe's front porch dining experience, ask if you can sit in the "East Wing," the spot where the original house sat until the early 1960s. It's not outdoor dining, but if you close your eyes, you can imagine the crisp ocean breeze that would have been present as Jennie served you back in the day. Dive into Joe's Menu The menu has something for everyone. If stone crabs aren't your thing (we know - it's hard to believe), try one of the many seafood options, steaks or the award-winning fried chicken, which was once endorsed by Paula Deen and is a bargain at $8.85 for half a chicken. Lighter fare includes salads, soups or appetizers. Weekly lunch and dinner specials change every Tuesday, so you'll want to check the website regularly . Remember to save room for dessert. The Key lime pie is not to be missed. Thick, creamy and tart, the filling sits atop a hand-pressed graham cracker delicately balanced with a dollop of fresh whipped cream. Coming in a close second, Joe’s Apple Pie is a fantastic runner-up contender. Layers of sliced apples, perfectly spiced and teeming with sweetness, are topped by a pecan crumble. Have it à la mode if you dare, but you might need a partner to help you finish off this decadent dessert. If you're looking for a quick seafood fix, pick-up is what you need so just head next door to Joe’s Take Away. Stone crabs, signature items and more await. Perfect for a crunch-time meal inside or your picnic basket for the beach, Joe’s Take Away offers daily paninis, soups, specials and menu standards such as tuna bowls, salads, turkey burgers, ceviche, lobster Rueben (a must-try) and a variety of fish sandwiches. Grab a bottle of bubbly as the final accompaniment and you’ve got yourself the ideal beachside feast. When you leave Joe's, don’t despair, Joe’s can come to you! Joe’s Shipping Department ships overnight, Monday to Friday, anywhere in the country. All in all, this legendary Miami Beach restaurant is a must-see if you are visiting or just in the neighborhood, so make sure to stop by and savor what Joe’s has to offer. You’ll be happy you did! By: Lori Kahn | May 21, 2020

50240.description: Located in the Esplanade at Aventura. JOEY Aventura brings a unique and refined dining experience to Miami’s exuberant atmosphere. This modern oasis spans two levels indoors, and features a large outdoor patio. Step into our 241-seat dining room, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, natural wood and stone elements, cascading Dre energy and captivating lighting installations. Helmed by award-winning Executive ChefMatthewStowe, JOEY Aventura invites guests to explore its internationally inspired menus for lunch and dinner. Signature starters include Roasted Corn Guacamole, Korean Fried Cauliflower, Szechuan Chicken Lettuce Wraps, Hibachi Wings and Truffle Parmesan Fries. The sushi selection features Seared Salmon SushiCones, while fresh salads include The Mercado Chicken Salad, Yellowfin Tuna Salad and Katsu Chicken Salad. Guests who love a good handheld can delight in Baja Fish Tacos or a customizable Hand-Pressed Burger flavored with JOEY’s secret sauce. The action is seen in the mains, which include Sake Glazed Chilean Sea Bass, Spaghetti Pomodoro and Cajun Blackened Chicken. Steak aficionados can select from JOEY Classic Steak, Steak & Ravioli Bianco and Steak with Lobster or Crab Cake, among others. Diners with a sweet tooth can complete their meal with any of JOEY’s classic desserts, such as the Individually Baked Apple Pie or Warm Italian Donuts.

50760.description: Hidden behind a picturesque pathway encompassed by lush jungle greenery and ambient lighting, sits joia beach, a day-to-night dining destination located in an exclusive enclave on Watson Island. Here, sun-drenched sands, sweeping views of Biscayne Bay and the city skyline, and vibrant pink-hued golden sunsets await. Opened in 2020 and designed by Francois Frossard, Joia beach has been hailed by Condé Nast traveler as one of "the best beaches in Miami." Described as one of the best places in Miami beach for "those craving a slick beach scene away from Miami beach’s masses," Joia beach is Miami's ultimate hidden oasis. Perfect for sunset cocktails, waterfront dinners, and weekend festivities, Joia beach has quickly become renowned as one of the best Miami Beach clubs and restaurants in the Magic City. European inspired bites and platters designed for sharing, handcrafted cocktails, and live djs and entertainment redefine south beach dining and transport you to a place of pure Joia.

Open nightly for dinner, Ke-uH offers a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere for date nights, celebrations and memorable dining experiences by the sea

6324.description: Komodo provides the allure of an ultra-chic environment paired with Pan-Asian cuisine that is second to none. Tucked away in the heart of Brickell’s financial district, this three-story indoor/outdoor restaurant seduces guests with its overstated décor all while providing a secluded escape within the bustling cityscape. The menu transports guests on an Asian adventure, seamlessly fusing classic dishes with new, innovative culinary feats. Using top-quality ingredients, each dish comes together as a work of art; teeming with flavor while maintaining visual appeal. Also noteworthy is Komodo’s handcrafted cocktail menu, available at each of the four expansive bars, including the posh, upstairs space; Komodo Lounge. The ideal space for any occasion, Komodo can accommodate private dining for large groups or intimate dinners. The venue boasts more than 300 seats including a mezzanine level, lush garden, and the venue’s most unique feature; elevated birds’ nests that create an playful treehouse feel perfect for any occasion day or night.

Other menu items include light bites, breads, salads and desserts. On the cocktail list, guests will find a generous selection of libations from handcrafted cocktails to culinary cocktails and mocktails. Outdoor seating is available. Korner67 also offers a daily happy hour, Monday through Friday from 3 to 6 p.m., and a brunch on the weekend from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.

57665.description: Discover a world of flavor at La Brisa, the acclaimed Latin fusion restaurant inside Miccosukee Casino & Resort. Our menu, a vibrant tapestry of seasonal ingredients and global techniques, brings bold Latin American tastes to new heights. Enjoy the energy of our open kitchen from the comfortable dining room or bask in the fresh, breezy ambiance of our outdoor patio, where the unique spirit of the Everglades meets the embrace of Latin hospitality. Join us at La Brisa for an elevated dining experience unlike any other – perfect for celebrations, date nights, or gathering with friends. Executive Chef Giovanni Genao joined Miccosukee Casino & Resort on June 1, 2026, bringing more than 30 years of culinary leadership across South Florida’s luxury hotels, resorts, casinos, and convention operations. With deep experience in high-volume banquets, resort dining, and large-scale culinary systems, Chef Giovanni blends Latin roots with global influences. His approach focuses on elevating food quality, developing people, and creating memorable guest experiences through discipline, creativity, and respect for every ingredient. Mac Metzler, Beverage Manager at Miccosukee Casino & Resort, oversees the property’s beverage programming, including La Brisa and Tempt Lounge. Originally from Mississippi and now based in Miami, he brings a practical, guest-focused approach to cocktail development. For the Miami Spice menu, Mac created a coffee-inspired cocktail selection that reflects Miami’s café culture while complementing the bold Latin flavors of La Brisa.

61887.description: Leonardo is an upscale Italian restaurant on Miami Beach’s Collins Avenue, offering handmade pasta, fresh seafood, and classic Italian dishes. The evening begins as an elegant fine dining dinner with white tablecloth service, curated wines, and craft cocktails then naturally evolves into a late night dining experience with live DJ entertainment, signature cocktails, and bottle service. Inspired by the golden era of Italian-American supper clubs from the 1930s–50s, the space features old-world design, intimate seating for upscale dining, and an outdoor patio. Open for dinner nightly with late night hours on weekends. Reservations available on OpenTable or Resy. Located at 2000 Collins Ave, Miami Beach!

Located in the Faena hotel in Miami Beach, Los Fuegos is an upscale Argentinian steak house with beautiful grand & lush décor where you can even eat outside near the pool. 56521.description: Mangrove is a Caribbean restaurant and lounge with soulful sounds and eclectic dishes. Mangrove is a vibrant Caribbean restaurant and lounge tucked away in Downtown Miami, accessible through, sister restaurant, Jrk!. This eclectic spot embodies relaxed sophistication, blending classic Jamaican flavors with modern elevations. The intimate, dimly lit atmosphere is filled with vintage details and tropical speakeasy vibes, complete with a full cocktail menu and vinyl records. As the evening progresses, Mangrove transforms from a dinner spot serving authentic Jamaican staples like whole fried snapper and jerk chicken, to a lively lounge with a bumping playlist. With its warm, inviting staff and immersive experience, Mangrove is a hidden gem that promises a fun and unforgettable night.

50569.description: Mayu, the latest addition to Aromas Del Peru's repertoire, celebrates the rich heritage of the Andes and Peru through its thoughtfully crafted menu. We are thrilled to announce the grand opening of Mayu - an exquisite Peruvian/Andean dining experience that promises to take your taste buds on a captivating journey through the flavors of Peru. At Mayu, we take immense pride in crafting an authentic and sophisticated culinary affair that encapsulates the essence of Peru's rich gastronomic and ancestral heritage. Our carefully curated menu features a blend of traditional Andean dishes and contemporary creations, all prepared with passion and inspiration from our homeland. Our grand opening is more than just a celebration; it's an opportunity for you to immerse yourself in the allure of the Pre-Inca culture, where every dish is a reflection of the country's diverse landscapes and historical influences. At Mayu, we have passionately woven together the finest ingredients and cooking techniques to ensure that each bite is a memorable experience. See you soon at Mayu - where Peruvian elegance comes to life!

767.description: Morton's The Steakhouse, Coral Gables exemplifies class and elegance in an ideal setting. For more than 30 years this restaurant has served the finest quality food, featuring USDA prime-aged beef, fresh fish and seafood, hand-picked produce, delicious appetizers and elegant desserts. Situated on the historic Miracle Mile in The City Beautiful, Morton’s Coral Gables is surrounded by world-renowned art galleries, boutiques, and international businesses. Whether dining for lunch or dinner, guests can enjoy the intimate outdoor patio, indulge inside the main dining room, or host private events both large and small in the boardroom. Total capacity is 267, and group capacity is 66.

2603.description: At News Cafe, every day begins with a sense of place. A gathering spot to linger over coffee, reconnect with loved ones, and watch Ocean Drive come alive, the iconic restaurant, bar, and newsstand that helped shape South Beach’s revival in the 1980s continues to operate from its original home inside The Tony Hotel at 804 Ocean Drive. Operated by Vida & Estilo Restaurant Group, News Café presents a curated Mediterranean-American menu rooted in nostalgia and designed for all-day enjoyment. Breakfast and daily brunch take center stage from the original Tony’s tomato soup, tuna melt, Aegean-Mediterranean plate, and classic eggs Benedict to indulgent French toast and Piña Colada pancakes layered with grilled pineapple and coconut syrup. It’s a menu that balances comfort and creativity, where truffle fries, a red-wine demi-glazed burger with smoked gouda, and shareable favorites keep the energy flowing from morning espresso to afternoon spritz. As the sun sets, the rhythm shifts. The Nine Edition arrives nightly from 9PM to close, an intentional late-night chapter that feels editorial, not promotional. Light bites. Easy drinks. All $9. Designed as an after-dinner ritual, it invites guests to linger a little longer with refined yet relaxed offerings. Golden, gooey Mozzarella Bites meet a glossy guava and Coca-Cola dip for a nostalgic, Miami-coded twist, while the Frozzie Rossie, a rosé-forward vodka cocktail with grapefruit sparkle, peach softness, and a delicate floral finish — delivers a crisp, modern nightcap. From sunrise brunch to after-hours bites and pours, News Café moves effortlessly through every day part, always fresh, always printed daily.

58652.description: Noe Sushi Bar is where Japanese tradition meets Ecuadorian soul. Founded over 20 years ago in Ecuador by Executive Chef Noé Carmona, our story is one of passion, perseverance, and culinary artistry. From humble beginnings to becoming Ecuador’s leading Japanese fusion restaurant, we now bring our legacy to South Miami. Each dish—70% crafted by Chef Noé himself—is a tribute to innovation, precision, and cultural harmony. With premium ingredients and bold creativity, we offer a refined sushi experience that’s both elevated and deeply rooted in heritage. This is Noe Sushi Bar: a story told through flavor, tradition, and craftsmanship.

3725.description: In 2022, celebrity chef Donatella embarked on her latest restaurant endeavor in her new home of Miami, Florida, NOMA Beach at Redfish. This iconic venue is located just inside Matheson Hammock Park and Marina, and is the only waterfront restaurant experience in Coral Gables. The property boasts a stunning rooftop patio with incredible ocean views, indoor and outdoor dining, and the perfect location for a surprise engagement, happy hour, graduation dinner, or dinner out with friends. NOMA Beach at Redfish is a hidden gem waterfront property that highlights celebrity chef Donatella’s signature seafood cuisine with Italian roots.

For us, there’s nothing more fulfilling than gathering around a plate of handmade pasta and enjoying each bite, sip, and shared moment with the people you care about most. From the inviting ambiance that welcomes you in to the lively atmosphere that sets the tone, the North Italia experience goes beyond flavor—It's about how it makes you feel!

Whether celebrating a corporate function, a family milestone, a holiday gathering, rehearsal dinner or graduation, our private dining rooms offer the perfect space to eat, drink and be merry. Let us do the work! Our team will work with you before, during and after, to ensure that every detail is done and that your event is unforgettable.

4220.description: Located in the heart of Key Biscayne, Novecento blends the warmth of Argentine hospitality with Mediterranean and Pan-Latin influences to create a vibrant neighborhood dining destination. For more than 25 years, the acclaimed restaurant group has been serving signature grilled steaks, house-made empanadas, fresh seafood, handcrafted pastas and an extensive selection of wines and cocktails in a welcoming atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and relaxed. Whether you're enjoying a leisurely lunch, happy hour, weekend brunch or dinner after a day at the beach, Novecento offers something for every occasion. With indoor and outdoor seating, attentive service and a menu rooted in quality ingredients and authentic flavors, it's a favorite among both locals and visitors exploring Key Biscayne.

13924.description: Novikov is a sophisticated world-renowned Chinese-Japanese concept, situated on a lively corner of Downtown Miami. Guests can enjoy the beautiful Miami weather while dining al fresco on the outside terrace, overlooking Biscayne Bay. Novikov is known for its colorful seafood and vegetable market display, whereby guests are encouraged to handpick the best and freshest items from a globally sourced, daily selection of seasonal ingredients. The Asian menu encompasses robata grill and wok dishes, along with an extensive dim sum and sushi selection.

59046.description: Embark on a contemporary fine-dining experience at NUNA at Four Seasons Hotel Miami. Led by Chef Jaime Pesaque, whose flagship restaurant Mayta in Lima was named one of The World’s 50 Best, NUNA offers a refined exploration of Nikkei cuisine—a vibrant fusion of Japanese precision and Peruvian soul. The menu highlights bold, artfully plated dishes such as scallop and octopus ceviche in rocoto leche de tigre, chirashi-style seafood over sushi rice with aji amarillo, and the signature NUNA roll layered with tuna, avocado, and crispy shrimp. Elevated hot offerings include Wagyu and lobster saltado finished with truffled potatoes and duck confit arroz con pato enriched with foie gras and a shoyu-glazed egg yolk. Set high above the Brickell skyline, NUNA invites you to discover a masterful cultural blend in an unforgettable rooftop setting.

22377.description: Osaka, the trailblazer of the Nikkei culinary boom, has been setting the trend in this gastronomic style since its first establishment in 2001. As the original Peruvian concept, Osaka pioneers an extraordinary culinary adventure, seamlessly fusing fresh ingredients, bold spices, and masterful techniques to create a symphony of vibrant flavors. This globally acclaimed restaurant, born at the forefront of the Nikkei movement, continues to shape and define the rich and evolving tapestry of gastronomy. Nestled within Osaka, the dining experience transcends ordinary boundaries. Culinary excellence takes center stage, crafting an exquisite symphony of innovative and high-quality dishes. The bar is a realm of redefined sophistication, where signature cocktails, born from innovative mixology, elevate the unique flavors of Nikkei cuisine, creating a dynamic drinking experience. The architecture serves as a cultural bridge, seamlessly merging Japanese and Peruvian influences, utilizing traditional materials fora visually stunning backdrop. Music adds the final layer, enhancing the atmosphere with an eclectic personality, carefully chosen tunes contributing to a holistic and unforgettable dining journey at Osaka.

62192.description: Ossobuco is a modern grilled cuisine. Fire, wood, meat and vegetables are the real stars of our restaurant. Chef and Grill Master Guillermo Eleicegui reflects his experience, creativity and respect for the product in a variety of dishes with influences from around the world. A global cuisine focused on the fines meats, using the best techniques of the open fire, in communion with organic and seasonal vegetables. Ossobuco proposes to value honest cuisine and treat each raw material with respect, bringing authenticity to the table in a relaxed atmosphere, ideal for sharing great moments with friends and family. In our dinning room, the privileged company of the asador joins us lighting the fire, to start the ritual, offering you a unique gastronomic experience. We trust those who are willing to enjoy what we do best: eat and drink well.

No stiff omakase rules here, it’s a place to swing by for a quick, high- quality lunch, or to settle in at the counter for the evening, chat with your neighbor, and let the energy of the room carry you.

54224.description: Transporting guests to the avenues of Paris, Pastis Miami design invokes the spirit of the original location in New York City. Special touches, including the iconic curved zinc bar, white subway tiles, and signature red banquettes, are showcased throughout the room. Gold-framed, hand-painted mirrors displaying the daily specials adorn the walls. Unique to Miami is a sprawling outdoor garden and courtyard that allows guests to enjoy the beautiful tropical weather from underneath a stunning enclosed pergola wrapped in black locust. Pastis offers crowd favorites such as Onion Soup; Escargots; a selection of Steak Frites; and the perfectly-made Cheeseburger à l’Américaine. New additions to the menu include French regional specialties like Big Eye Tuna Carpaccio dressed in lemon-leek vinaigrette, and Red Snapper Provençal that bring tastes of the South of France to Florida. Raw bar platters and bread baskets abound. And, bien sûr, what is a night out without bubbles or rose? The list of cocktails, wines, and beer will keep the celebration going all night long.

57884.description: Pauline is a coastal Miami restaurant and bar rooted in the spirit of South Florida, where Latin and Caribbean influences shape a menu inspired by the sea. Located in the heart of The Shelborne by Proper, Pauline unfolds beneath soaring windows and abundant natural light, creating an airy gathering place that moves naturally from morning coffee and lunch into cocktails, dinner, and the energy of the evening. Refined but relaxed, the menu is guided by seasonality, bright flavors, pristine seafood, and a sense of generosity. Led by Culinary Director Abram Bissell, a Florida Keys native whose career includes Michelin-starred kitchens at The Modern, NoMad, and Eleven Madison Park, Pauline brings a thoughtful, ingredient-driven approach to the flavors of the coast. The Crudo section features Cinco Conchas, conch ceviche, and Key West pink shrimp, while signature dishes such as tuna ceviche, lobster fideos, whole crispy red snapper, johnny cake, and cou-cou reflect the restaurant’s Caribbean and Latin influences through the lens of modern Miami. Named for Pauline Baker, wife and muse of celebrated cocktail writer Charles H. Baker Jr., the restaurant takes inspiration from their travels through Latin America and the glamour of Deco-era Miami. The result is a dining experience that feels open, social, transportive, and deeply connected to the rhythm of South Florida.

26765.description: Petralunga specializes in delivering gourmet pizza with healthy whole grain dough, a pinch of gold turmeric, high quality ingredients, and a bunch of creativity! Every bite is carefully crafted and made to share like the customer favorite Cacio e Pepe Truffle pizza and Patanegra pizza with burrata stracciatella cheese. Petralunga also specializes in Roman Style Pizza, 16-inch or 12-inch size, thin and crispy. The most loved is the Brusklyn, topped with tomato sauce, garlic oil, pepperoni, stracciatella cheese, basil, hot honey and parmesan flakes. Since 2024 thin gluten-free pizza has also been available. If you’re not in the mood for pizza, the menu draws influence from the coasts of Italy with dishes like whole grilled branzino, octopus alla siciliana, tartare di tonno and pasta dishes with seafood of the day. The menu is designed with wine and cocktail pairings in mind, and Petralunga features over 150 types of tequila in the mixology bar. The environment is elegant, comfy, light and playful and includes a panoramic view of the bay and the marina of North Bay Village. Pets are also welcome. Checkout our website www.petralunga.com for our weekly offers (Pasta Lovers, Tequila Pizza Tuesday, Ladies’ Lychee Martini Night, Wine Lovers and Happy Hour) and link to reserve. We are open Monday to Friday from 5 p.m. and Saturday & Sunday from 1 p.m. Free, easily accessible parking is available, as well as free parking for boats under 45 feet (call to reserve boat spaces). Contacts: +1(305)615-6671; info@petralunga.com Instagram: @petralungamiami

62431.description: At Piccola Pizzeria, we don’t just serve Italian food—we deliver an unforgettable Italian experience. Every pizza, pasta, and signature dish is crafted from time-honored family recipes and the freshest ingredients to create flavors that keep guests coming back for more. Whether you're gathering with family, celebrating a special occasion, or enjoying a night out, you'll discover authentic Italian cuisine, exceptional service, and a vibrant atmosphere that turns every meal into a memorable event. Piccola Pizzeria brings the heart of Italy straight to your table. From handcrafted pizzas to authentic family recipes passed down through generations, every bite is packed with bold, unforgettable taste. Guests choose Piccola Pizzeria for authentic Italian dining. Our expertly crafted menu features traditional family recipes, premium fresh ingredients, and flavors inspired by the finest Italian kitchens. Whether you're sharing a meal with loved ones or enjoying a romantic evening, you'll be treated to exceptional food, welcoming service, and an atmosphere designed to make every visit special. Come hungry, leave delighted, and experience the true taste of Italy today.

26416.description: Experience a Peruvian-inspired take on the classic Prime Steakhouse at Platea Miami, a modern craft-steakhouse and ceviche bar curated and owned by Chef Patron Fernando Salazar & Andres Marmolejos. Featuring USDA Prime Steaks and the freshest seafood, Platea's menu offerings include an assortment of ceviches, enticing starters like the aji de gallina bites and bone marrow, salad favorites such as the Charred Ceasar and signature prime Steaks & Seafood entrees with bold Peruvian flavors that include the Prime Tomahawk, Prime Dino-Rib and Galapagos Stuffed Lobster Tail. Located in Pinecrest, Platea is open for dinner on Tuesdays to Sundays from 6 to 10 p.m.

22749.description: Located in the heart of Miami, Primo's Italian Restaurant and Bar offers a blend of vibrant ambiance and delectable cuisine. With a prime location just minutes from downtown Miami, it's the perfect spot for both locals and visitors to enjoy a memorable dining experience. Primo's Italian Restaurant and Bar has been delighting guests for over 20 years. Renowned for its exceptional cuisine and full bar, it has become a favorite for its flavorful dishes and expertly crafted drinks. At Primo's, we pride ourselves on offering a welcoming atmosphere, whether you're here for a leisurely lunch, a business meeting, or a night out. Our restaurant offers a full range of services, from regular dining to special events, ensuring there's something for everyone. As an exciting new addition, Primos Express now opens daily at 8 a.m., offering breakfast and convenient grab-and-go options. Guests can enjoy the same exceptional quality and care that have made the restaurant a local favorite. For reservations or inquiries, please contact us. Whether you’re planning a casual outing or a private event, Primo's Italian Restaurant and Bar offers the perfect blend of great food, excellent service, and a lively atmosphere.

24786.description: Located in the heart of Overtown, Red Rooster serves comfort food celebrating the roots of American cuisine and the diverse culinary traditions of the neighborhood. At Red Rooster we want to share the story of Overtown with our guests, and offer a platform to celebrate local artists, musicians, and culinary talents. We embrace today's Overtown with the spirit of inclusiveness and community by hiring our family of staff from within the community; inspiring better eating through buying from local purveyors. Overtown is a unique and historically rich neighborhood that we are honored to be a part of. We invite you to please join us and share in the spirit of Overtown at Red Rooster, where Chef Marcus Samuelsson brings his passion for food to the neighborhood.

25118.description: Combining Miami Beach’s vibrant culture with a chef-driven culinary vision, Rum Room is one of Miami Beach’s best-known spots for locals and visitors to find innovative, seasonally inspired menus in a relaxed, inviting atmosphere. Rum Room is a neighborhood restaurant available to host special events for any occasion. In addition to the main dining room, which seats 48 guests, the waterside terrace can seat up to 50 guests and provides a memorable backdrop overlooking historic Collins Canal. Venu, located adjacent to the main restaurant, accommodates up to 100 guests in an airy yet sophisticated space. Rum Room & Venu is located in one of the oldest public buildings in the heart of Miami Beach on the campus of the Miami Beach Convention Center.

2397.description: Scope out the Miami skyline over brunch, lunch or dinner at this iconic Key Biscayne waterfront eatery. Located in Rickenbacker Marina, the Rusty Pelican offers an ambiance of seaside sophistication, spectacular sunset views and a menu of contemporary cuisine with a subtle Latin twist. Dining options include an ample selection of raw bar and seafood entrees like the Chilean sea bass with smoked sweet plantain mash, grilled peppers and mango-papaya salsa. Or if you’re not in the mood for seafood, opt for one of the tempting meat entrees like the tequila marinated organic chicken with sweet corn arepas, white cabbage shishito pepper slaw and homemade mole. Looking forward to a round of cocktails before dinner? Choose from the restaurant’s expansive menu of cocktails, spirits, wine, sake and beer. And during the week, you can enjoy appetizer and drink specials at the Rusty Pelican’s 4pm to 7pm Happy Hour.

26996.description: Sala'o draws inspiration from its Cuban roots to prepare mouthwatering seafood dishes, with an homage to the honorary Cuban himself, Ernest Hemingway and his book "The Old Man and the Sea". In a little corner of Miami's popular Calle Ocho, Sala'o transports you to the early 1950's with bold dishes and a selection of handcrafted, tableside gin & tonics created to invoke adventure. From seafood to quality meats, the chef has curated a menu that accents traditional Cuban seafood dishes with his signature flavors. Sala'o also features live entertainment reminiscent of the nostalgic days of "Cuba Libre". Sala'o is open daily for dinner from 12:00 PM to midnight. Pickup and delivery hours are daily from 12 noon to 9 p.m.

6496.description: Santorini by Giorgios offers fresh Mediterranean cuisine which embraces Greek culture. They have something for everyone, whether it’s an after-work drink with tapas, lunchtime meal, a romantic meal or a special celebration. Find specialties like flaming cheese saganaki, chicken souvlaki, lamb kebab with couscous, and a variety of fresh seafood, wood oven pizza, Greek pasta and salads. Try $5 mezes and specially-priced drinks during their daily happy hour. Enjoy your meal in their casually-elegant dining room or poolside on their patio, just steps from the beach. They are located in the Hilton Bentley Miami/South Beach . Make your reservation online or call (305)672-6624. They are open daily for breakfast from 7 a.m. to 11 a.m. and for lunch/dinner from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Happy hour is from 3 p.m. to 6 p.m. daily. Check their website to learn about special events , like the New Year’s Eve Poolside Party and New Year’s Day Recovery Brunch.

4175.description: Seasons 52 is a fresh grill and wine bar that offers a seasonal menu inspired by the fresh appeal of a farmer's market and what's good now. With signature items like Cedar Plank-Roasted Salmon, Filet Mignon, Flatbreads and Mini Indulgence desserts, guests are free to explore in a multi-course experience. The menu is paired with an ever-changing collection of more than 100 wines, 52 available by the glass, along with exceptional signature handcrafted cocktails. 62198.description: Perched on the 54th floor of 830 Brickell, Seia offers a refined contemporary Italian dining experience paired with sweeping views of the Miami skyline and Biscayne Bay. Inspired by the Roman goddess of growth and harvest, the restaurant celebrates seasonality through an elevated culinary philosophy that expresses a contemporary interpretation of Italian tradition. Under the culinary direction of The Bastion Collection, each dish is grounded in seasonality, shaped by craftsmanship and guided by a deep respect for ingredients at their natural peak. With a balance of precision and restraint, every plate allows the clarity of flavor and sense of place to define the experience. Open for executive lunch, aperitivo and dinner, Seia is an exceptional destination for business lunches, date nights and special occasions. Guests can enjoy handcrafted cocktails, an expertly curated wine program and seasonal menus served in an elegant setting that combines contemporary design with breathtaking panoramic views of Downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay.

26362.description: Sexy Fish offers a tantalizing lunch and dinner dining experience in the heart of Brickell's financial district. The Miami outpost of the London-based Sexy Fish restaurant concept features an underwater world inspired interior with original Damien Hirst artwork, delectable Asian-inspired menus, theatrical cocktails and when the sun sets, international DJ and thematic entertainment are added to the late night experience. Sexy Fish Chef Director has curated an Asian-inspired menu that juxtaposes incredible flavor and impeccable technique. Best experienced shared, the a la carte and tasting menus are available all day, while the Set Lunch menu ($34 - 4 courses) is available Monday to Friday. Vegetarian and vegan menu options are also available. The restaurant is open Monday through Wednesday and Sunday from 12:00 noon to 12:00 midnight; and Thursday through Saturday from 12:00 noon to 2 a.m.

1144.description: Located in the heart of Miami Beach, STK blends a modern steakhouse with a chic lounge. Crocodile tiles, theatrical table lighting and a DJ create a luxurious and dynamic ambience. Expect excellent service and superior quality. Start your experience with a unique cocktail like the Strawberry Cobbler, which is served in a graham cracker-rimmed glass. Although steak, think New York strip, Wagyu and Tomahawk, is the main attraction here, you can also find fresh local snapper, organic chicken and Australian lamb on the menu. Don’t forget to try their signature Parmesan truffle fries. Visit during happy hour to sip on specially-priced cocktails and small bites from 3:30 p.m. - 8 p.m. on weekdays, and 6 p.m. till closing time on Thursday and Sunday. The restaurant is housed in the 1 Hotel South Beach , which offers valet parking. Reservations are recommended and can be made online. Private and semi-private dining options are available. Dinner hours are 6 p.m. - close.

49051.description: Sun, surf, sushi at Sushi Bichi, celebrating the culinary coastlines of the world’s most vibrant cultures in a beautiful, tropical Miami Beach location adjacent to the ocean in a serene, lush outdoor setting. Executive Chef Byron Alabado and Executive Sushi Chef Shoyo Iida craft meticulous sushi, fire-cooked street skewers, inventive small plates and large entrees, plus fresh raw bar, ceviches & tiraditos that echo the authenticity of Japan, The Philippines, Mexico, Peru, Brazil, Israel and The West Indies. A 360 degree bar features fresh handcrafted Bichi cocktails, premium Japanese sake, wonderful wines and Champagnes, and an international beer selection. Guests are greeted by a ceremonial Japanese torii gate - after passing through, the ordinary world is left behind, symbolically marking the transition from the mundane to the sacred. Sushi Bichi reservation bookings are subject to weather conditions.
