58274.description: Sushi Club offers a vibrant fusion of Japanese tradition and Latin flair in the heart of Brickell. Known for its chic ambiance and creative menu, Sushi Club serves a diverse selection of handcrafted sushi, signature rolls, and innovative Nikkei cuisine, blending fresh ingredients with bold flavors. Whether you're dining inside the stylish lounge, enjoying open-air seating, or sipping cocktails at the bar, Sushi Club delivers a unique experience. The menu features expertly crafted dishes like the Acevichado Roll and Salmon Nikkei, as well as curated cocktails and a premium sake selection. 61988.description: Tacos Atarantados was born in Monterrey, serving Northern Mexican tacos made with character. The trompo is its flag and the table is its meeting point. The food is meant to be shared, enjoyed, and repeated. But Tacos Atarantados is not just about flavor, it is about warm service, genuine hospitality, and tables where there is always room for one more. The restaurant believes in salsas that transform every taco and keep guests coming back for more. In Mexico, Atarantado describes that slightly dazed, distracted feeling you get when you lock eyes with a spinning trompo, when the pastor is sliced just right, and when the craving takes over. You pause. You forget what you were saying. You need that taco immediately. Real Monterrey flavor, authentic street energy, meat sizzling, and salsas that wake you up and keep you coming back, because when a taco is truly well served, happiness is guaranteed and one bite is all it takes.

61458.description: Founded by chef Tam Pham and Harrison Ramhofer, Tâm Tâm was born from a passion for bringing authentic, hard-to-find Vietnamese flavors to Miami. What began in 2019 as intimate home dinners for friends and family quickly evolved into the sold-out underground supper club, Phamily Kitchen. Following a successful residency as the first pop-up at 1-800 Lucky in 2020, Tâm Tâm gained a devoted following through acclaimed pop-ups across Miami. After refining the concept through a celebrated four-month run at Low Key in 2023, Tâm Tâm opened its flagship downtown Miami restaurant in May 2023. Today, Tâm Tâm is recognized as one of Miami’s standout dining destinations, earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2024, while chef Tam Pham received the Michelin Guide’s 2024 Young Chef Award.Inspired by "quán nhậu" - Vietnamese for drinking places, Tâm Tâm is a small, loud, and lively restaurant serving chef-driven Vietnamese drinking food and wine bar. We offer a constantly changing menu with a sommelier-curated wine list along with frozen drinks and others. Located in downtown Miami, in the back of the historic Dade County courthouse.

20578.description: Tatore brings the warmth and tradition of Italian family dining to North Miami Beach with recipes passed down through generations. The restaurant specializes in fresh homemade pasta, stone-fired pizzas, classic milanesas, grilled meats and seafood, and house-made artisan gelato. At the heart of the menu are more than 20 varieties of stone-fired pizza, including the signature stuffed Fugazzetta, along with an extensive selection of short, long, and stuffed pastas prepared with sauces made from scratch and cooked to order. Guests can also enjoy traditional Italian favorites, fresh salads, grilled skirt steak, salmon, chicken piccata, and a tempting selection of desserts. With its welcoming atmosphere and focus on handcrafted food, Tatore is an inviting destination for family meals, casual lunches, dinners with friends, and anyone looking to enjoy authentic Italian flavors in Greater Miami & Miami Beach.

The Drexel team is comprised of industry veterans who have brought their passion to the table, creating a restaurant for locals, by locals. Chef Nano Crespo has mastered a rustic, straight forward cooking style which he continues at his new home with the founders behind Mandolin. Offering clean flavors from the charcoal grill and wood oven, the menu includes house made pasta and pizza with a heavy emphasis on locally sourced seafood and an entire section dedicated to vegetable dishes. The menu also pairs well with our well curated cocktail list and rare boutique wines.

58670.description: Now open along that historic tourist magnet, Española Way, is The Joyce, a steakhouse with a dark, speakeasy-esque atmosphere. It’s the first venture from the group Spicy Hospitality, which is made up of art collector Andre Sakhai, entrepreneur Marc Lotenberg and Chef James Taylor. The restaurant, located next to Paperfish Sushi, seats 45, with a sleek modern bar, and serves classic steakhouse cuisine. Taylor, who trained at Le Cordon Bleu in Chicago, has worked at three different Michelin-starred restaurants. He began his career at Bavette’s Bar & Bouef in Chicago, which has one star, then moved on to another starred restaurant, Roister, where he was executive sous chef. Later, he was chef de tournant at Alinea, which earned a coveted three-star Michelin rating. The menu at The Joyce includes seafood as well as steaks, including shrimp cocktail, crudo, a snapper filet sandwich and King Crab scampi, plus items like caviar and latkes. The cuts of meat include ribeye and A5 wagyu. But dining at The Joyce extends beyond its dimly lit walls. There’s also The Window at the Joyce, which opened in December and is also overseen by Taylor, who wanted to offer the best possible burger to customers. At The Window, diners can order more than burgers, though. The menu also includes fish and chicken sandwiches, wings, milkshakes, chopped salads and more. You can order at the window for takeout or grab a bite and sit outside on the patio and enjoy the Miami Beach breeze.

4591.description: Visit The Strand at Carillon Miami for a Mediterranean contemporary dining experience. Our carefully crafted menu sources ingredients from local farms and places a spotlight on Florida’s organic community. Take a seat at The Strand’s contemporary indoor/outdoor space that sits directly at the ocean’s edge and enjoy clean, fresh, ingredient-led cuisine. Come and mingle in the cocktail bar, enjoy the scenic views, delight your taste buds and listen to the waves crashing from the oceanfront patio. Breakfast and lunch are served daily and dinner is available Wednesday - Sunday. Sitting at the helm is the main dining room, an open and natural contemporary space accented by warm woods, earth tones and hues of gold, creating a refuge for guests and locals alike to gather, mingle and indulge. Accommodates up to 98. Steps away from The Strand’s beachfront views, the re-imagined Ocean Terrace and Gallery is the closest beachfront lounge in Miami. Boasting a nature-inspired design, the venue highlights accents from a trellis overhang to a glass-covered walkway. Accommodates up to 106.

A curated wine list and inventive cocktail program invite guests to linger from happy hour into the evening. With a vibrant atmosphere, quality ingredients, and a deep respect for Miami’s diverse culinary identity, TIN TIN is designed to be a true gathering place where Miami cuisine is shared, reimagined, and celebrated.

26155.description: Founded in Phoenix, Arizona, in 2008, True Food Kitchen is a restaurant and lifestyle brand inspired by the philosophy that food should make you feel better, not worse, and that great tasting food and thoughtfully crafted beverages can serve as the foundation for a life well lived. The restaurant brand is driven by a passionate collective of accomplished chefs, visionary restauranteurs, and a renowned doctor of integrative medicine – who believe delicious dining and conscious nutrition can go hand in hand, without sacrificing flavor, creativity, or indulgence. True Food’s seasonal menu is guided by the principles of Dr. Andrew Weil’s anti-inflammatory food pyramid. True Food Kitchen emphasizes wholesome, simple ingredients with simple preparations to highlight the natural health benefits and flavors of each ingredient. From nutrient-dense staples and carefully sourced proteins to little-known superfoods, True Food Kitchen is committed to sourcing the most responsible, creative, freshest, in-season ingredients. With the opening of its newest location in Miami, True Food Kitchen will have 42 locations in 17 states: including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Nashville, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia.

437.description: Two Chefs widely celebrated cuisine is unique-embodying and elegant restraint and a purity of ingredients seasoned with years of “Know How” that charm the palate. Chef Jan Jorgensen and his team innovate weekly menus featuring local and seasonal creations, complemented with legendary signature dishes and famous towering soufflés. Our dishes are ALL in FLAVOR and ALL MEMORABLE. All culinary guides and critics have acknowledged Two Chefs achievements since our beginning in 1994, not to mention Chef Jorgensen’s career, which began in 1980. The restaurant’s interior has been conceived as a subtle portrait, contemporary and innovate, yet mindful of tradition. The dining room allows a view of the craftsmanship kitchen, sparkled with amber glows from the wood burning oven, where skillful chefs execute clean and exciting diches-which are then delivered by a professional wait staff walking the tight rope between proper and relaxed. Our restaurant is conveniently located a short distance from Miami International Airport, popular beaches, shopping and top notch hotels-making Two Chefs a distinctive destination for custom catered private affairs, as well as lunches and dinners that are intimately crafted and served. Our casual and elegant bar offers an extensive selection or world class spirits, perfectly shaken, mixed or stirred. It’s the perfect setting for a relaxing evening with friends. Two Chefs popular cooking school is the perfect tool for team building, as well as “Just Having a Good Time”. Despite increasing changes in South Florida’s gastronomic circuit, Two Chefs retains the vibe and outlook of a serious neighborhood restaurant.

62559.description: Yamashiro Miami is an elevated rooftop destination on located on the 9th floor of the Gale Hotel and Residences. Our Japanese inspired design, zen garden elements, and skyline views create a multi-sensory dining experience. The menu features sushi, sashimi, makis, warm plates, and premium American and Japanese Wagyu steaks, with signature dishes like Wagyu Tomahawk, Hiramasa Ceviche, Katsu Sando, King Crab, and Specialty Cut Rolls. Our cocktail program blends Japanese flavors with tropical influences for a truly immersive experience. Perfect for in􀆟mate dinners, birthdays, corporate events, or full venue buyouts, we offer customizable menus, indoor/outdoor spaces, and elevated hospitality. Our dress code helps maintain the refined and welcoming atmosphere. We kindly ask guests to observe an elegant and contemporary style: No sportswear, shorts, sleeveless shirts, flip-flops, or hats. Please note we include a 20% service charge on all checks.

63358.description: Located in Upper Buena Vista, Yoso Sushi offers an intimate Japanese dining experience rooted in tradition, sustainability and creativity. What began as a food truck in Miami's Design District has evolved into a brick-and-mortar restaurant where skilled sushi chefs showcase high-quality ingredients through precise techniques and thoughtful presentation. The menu blends the traditions of Japanese cuisine with Miami's vibrant culinary influences, featuring nigiri, sashimi, handrolls, maki, poke bowls and seasonal specialties made with sustainably sourced ingredients. Guests can also explore chef-selected tastings, sake selections and signature experiences, including personalized omakase at the intimate sushi counter and seasonal tasting menus. With a setting inspired by Tokyo's vintage charm and Miami's Art Deco style, Yoso Sushi delivers a refined yet approachable experience for a casual lunch, dinner or special occasion.

3955.description: Experience chef Rainer Becker’s internationally renowned style of modern Japanese izakaya at Zuma, one of the recent additions to the Zuma portfolio of 15 worldwide locations that includes London, Hong Kong, Bangkok, Rome, Istanbul and New York. Ensconced in the lobby of the Kimpton Epic Hotel, Zuma offers an inventive take on traditional Japanese dishes that are meant to be shared. Guests can choose from the dinner menu of starters, robata-grilled and donburi signature entrees as well as sushi. The bold-flavored dinner menu features standouts like prawn and black cod dumplings, beef tenderloin spiced with red chili, sesame and sweet soy or a savory rice hotpot of wild mushrooms and Japanese vegetables, among others. Sake-lovers can enjoy Zuma’s impressive sake list of 80 imported varieties as well as an assortment of heritage cocktails and Japanese beers.

ftl-23727.description:
Perched directly on the sand at  Lauderdale‑by‑the‑Sea ,  Aruba Beach Cafe  delivers the kind of breezy, beachfront energy visitors crave. This Caribbean‑inspired restaurant pairs  oceanfront dining  with a lively, island‑style atmosphere—complete with  nightly live music , tropical cocktails, and a menu full of fresh seafood and American‑Caribbean favorites. 

 Guests can sip a rum punch with their toes practically in the sand, enjoy  live island entertainment seven days a week , or stop by for one of the restaurant’s themed happy‑hour celebrations like Martini Mondays, Tequila Tuesdays, and Mojito Thursdays. On Sundays, Aruba Beach Cafe becomes a favorite brunch spot, serving hearty breakfast plates and beachside Bloody Marys from 10 a.m. to noon. 

 Located at the entrance to Lauderdale‑by‑the‑Sea’s iconic pier, Aruba Beach Cafe is a go‑to for ocean views, upbeat vibes, and dining that feels like vacation—whether you’re here for lunch, dinner, cocktails, or late‑night dancing.

ftl-24124.description:
Welcome to  Black Jack’s Rum Bar & Grille, in both Davie and Flagler Village, FL . It’s where the food’s utterly delicious, the drinks are strong, and the fun is non-negotiable. Our menu is stacked. Burgers? Massive. Steaks? Sizzling. Fish & Chips? Crispy perfection. If you’re feeling coastal or want something lighter, we’ve got ceviche, fresh snapper, and an authentic paella. But don’t kid yourself. This is where flavor comes to flex. 

 We’ve also got South Florida’s  largest  and most unique rum collection, and we’re not afraid to pour it. Rare finds. Bold blends. Smooth sippers. Whether you’re after a perfectly muddled mojito, exotic rum flight, or a cocktail that hits harder than a cannonball with the wind at its back, we’ve got you covered. 

 So, what’s stopping you? Swing by when hunger strikes or you’re ready for a killer drink. We’ll be here, ready to serve up the good stuff.

ftl-24117.description:
Bodega Taqueria y Tequila  brings together bold Mexican-inspired flavors, handcrafted cocktails, and a lively atmosphere that has made it a South Florida favorite. Known for its scratch-made tacos, burritos, quesadillas, fresh guacamole, and award-winning margaritas, Bodega offers a unique dining experience that seamlessly transitions from casual dining to vibrant nightlife. 

 During  Dine Out Lauderdale 2026 , guests are invited to enjoy specially curated prix-fixe menus available  Sunday through Thursday . The  $35 Lunch Menu  (available 12 PM–3 PM in the Shack) includes totopos with a choice of house-made dip, a choice of two tacos or a quesadilla, churros, and a Frozen Margarita. For dinner, guests can choose between a  $45 Dinner Menu  or a  $60 Dinner for Two Menu  (available 5 PM–9 PM in the Lounge), featuring favorites like fresh chips and dip, tacos, burritos, quesadillas, churros, and a selection of handcrafted cocktails or refreshing mocktails. 

 Whether stopping by for a quick lunch, date night, or an evening with friends, Bodega Taqueria y Tequila offers an unforgettable combination of bold flavors, handcrafted drinks, and an energetic atmosphere that captures the spirit of Fort Lauderdale.

ftl-24129.description: Bravo Peruvian Kitchen in Wilton Manors has been serving authentic Peruvian cuisine since 2008, earning a reputation as one of South Florida’s favorite dining destinations. Proudly recognized as Fort Lauderdale Magazine’s Best Peruvian Restaurant for five consecutive years, Bravo is known for its fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and warm hospitality. Guests can enjoy an extensive menu featuring Peru’s most iconic dishes, including fresh ceviches, Lomo Saltado, Ají de Gallina, seafood specialties, handcrafted cocktails, and homemade desserts. During Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, Bravo Peruvian Kitchen invites guests to discover the rich culinary traditions of Peru through a specially curated menu that showcases the vibrant flavors, quality ingredients, and genuine hospitality that have made Bravo a local favorite for over 18 years. Whether visiting for the first time or returning as a loyal guest, every meal is an invitation to experience the taste of Peru in the heart of Wilton Manors.

ftl-23978.description:
Experience the flavors of Southern Italy at Casa Calabria, Fort Lauderdale's beloved oceanfront dining destination located inside Ocean Manor Beach Resort. Inspired by generations of family recipes, Casa Calabria brings authentic Italian hospitality to every table with handmade pastas, fresh seafood, premium steaks, and expertly crafted specialties prepared with imported ingredients and time-honored traditions. 

 Pair your meal with a selection from our curated wine list or indulge in one of our handcrafted cocktails while enjoying the warm glow of our elegant dining room, live piano entertainment, and stunning beachfront atmosphere. From romantic date nights to unforgettable evenings with friends, every visit is designed to transport you straight to the Italian coast. 

 Join us during Dine Out Lauderdale 2026 and discover why locals and visitors alike return for our exceptional cuisine, delicious cocktails, impeccable service, and one-of-a-kind oceanfront setting. Whether you're savoring fresh seafood, twirling handmade pasta, or ending the evening with a decadent house-made dessert, Casa Calabria promises an unforgettable dining experience from the first sip to the last bite.

ftl-23608.description: Experience the timeless elegance of Casa D'Angelo during Dine Out Lauderdale 2026. Renowned for Chef Angelo Elia's authentic Italian cuisine, impeccable service, and award-winning wine program, Casa D'Angelo invites guests to savor a specially curated multi-course menu that showcases the finest flavors of Italy. From handmade pastas and fresh seafood to expertly prepared signature entrées and decadent desserts, each dish reflects the restaurant's commitment to tradition, quality, and culinary excellence. Set in an elegant atmosphere just moments from Las Olas, Dine Out Lauderdale is the perfect opportunity to discover why Casa D'Angelo has remained one of South Florida's premier dining destinations for more than 25 years. Join us for an unforgettable dining experience where classic Italian hospitality meets exceptional value.

ftl-23681.description: Casablanca Cafe is a historic staple on the Fort Lauderdale beach. Preservation of the original architectural aesthetics are prevalent throughout including the original working fireplace, wooden ceiling beams, spiral staircase, and terrazzo floors dating back to the 1920’s. And while the venue serves as a visual homage to the old-timey beachfront luxury lifestyle, the menu transports guests to a modern take on New American and Mediterranean fusion. Sipping crafted cocktails beach side, or indulging in the fresh locally sourced seafood specials, Casablanca Cafe serves up an intimate experience of culinary excellence. Seating options are plentiful, with two floors – upstairs via the iconic spiral staircase, downstairs dining room or outside patio, each have its own unique charm with soft ocean breezes and sweeping ocean views.

Chima Steakhouse Fort Lauderdale  invites you to experience a refined three-course dinner during Dine Out Lauderdale. 

 Begin your evening with our signature Brazilian cheese bread and an elegant Gourmet Salad Bar featuring over 35 premium selections, including Beef Carpaccio, Smoked Salmon, imported cheeses, artisan charcuterie, seasonal vegetables, chef-prepared hot dishes, and other sophisticated specialties. 

 For your entrée, enjoy a curated Rodizio Experience with continuous tableside service of Chima favorites, including Top Sirloin (Picanha), Garlic Top Sirloin, Top Sirloin with Jalapeño & Chimichurri, Filet Mignon Wrapped in Bacon, Lamb Picanha, Aji Chicken Thighs, Beer-Marinated Drumsticks, Brazilian Sausage, Cheddar Sausage, Grilled Brazilian Coalho Cheese with Hot Honey, and Cinnamon Grilled Pineapple. Your meal is accompanied by traditional Brazilian side dishes, including creamy mashed potatoes, crispy fried polenta, and fried bananas. 

 Complete your evening with your choice of Chocolate Cake or New York Style Cheesecake with fresh berries and strawberry sauce. 

 Discover the warmth of Brazilian hospitality and the signature dining experience that has made Chima Steakhouse a South Florida favorite.

ftl-23850.description:
Daniel's, A Florida Steakhouse  

 Experience a true taste of the Sunshine State at Daniel's, A Florida Steakhouse, where premium steaks, fresh Florida seafood, and locally sourced ingredients come together in an elevated dining experience. Inspired by Florida's rich culinary heritage, the menu showcases exceptional cuts of beef from North and Central Florida ranches, seasonal produce, and the freshest seafood from the Florida Keys, all thoughtfully prepared by an expert culinary team. 

 With its warm hospitality, sophisticated ambiance, award-winning wine program, and expertly crafted cocktails, Daniel's is the perfect destination for everything from intimate dinners and celebrations to memorable nights out. Whether you're indulging in a perfectly grilled steak, fresh oysters, or signature Florida-inspired specialties, every meal reflects the restaurant's commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and the flavors of the state. 

 Located in the heart of Fort Lauderdale, Daniel's offers an upscale yet welcoming atmosphere where guests can savor exceptional cuisine and genuine hospitality in every visit.

ftl-23680.description:
E41 Las Olas invites guests to discover the vibrant flavors of Peru through a contemporary Nikkei dining experience that blends Peruvian tradition with Japanese precision. Located in the heart of Las Olas Boulevard, the restaurant is known for its fresh ceviches, handcrafted sushi rolls, premium seafood, flavorful wok dishes, and award-worthy Pisco cocktails, all served in a lively and welcoming atmosphere. 

 As part of  Dine Out Lauderdale 2026 , E41 Las Olas offers specially curated prix-fixe lunch and dinner menus that showcase some of the restaurant's signature dishes while introducing guests to the richness and diversity of Peruvian cuisine. Each menu has been thoughtfully designed to provide exceptional value without compromising quality, making it the perfect opportunity for both first-time visitors and returning guests to experience one of South Florida's most exciting culinary destinations. 

 Whether enjoying a business lunch, a date night, or dinner with family and friends, guests can expect warm hospitality, bold flavors, beautifully crafted dishes, and an unforgettable dining experience. From the first bite of fresh ceviche to the last sip of a perfectly shaken Pisco Sour, E41 Las Olas celebrates the best of Peru with every visit. 

 Join E41 Las Olas from  August 1 through September 30  and experience why Peruvian Nikkei cuisine continues to captivate food lovers from around the world.

ftl-24002.description:
Experience an unforgettable evening at Farraddays Steakhouse, Harrahs Casino Pompano Beach premier dining destination. For Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, our Chef has crafted an exclusive menu that showcases the quality our guests have come to expect. 

 For your first course, choose between a refreshing Citrus Burrata Salad with vibrant oranges, pistachios, and creamy burrata, or our rich and savory French Onion Soup topped with Gruyère, Swiss cheese, and a buttery crouton. 

 Entrée selections celebrate both land and sea. Enjoy our Potato-Crusted Golden Tilefish, accompanied by sautéed leeks and spinach, silky potato purée, cabernet reduction, and grilled lemon, or savor the signature Prime Bone-In Cowgirl Ribeye, served with garlic-roasted smashed fingerlings, blistered heirloom tomatoes, and grilled asparagus. 

 Conclude your dining experience with a decadent dessert choice, including a tropical Mango Passionfruit Cheesecake paired with mango sorbet, or a classic New York Cheesecake finished with fresh berry sauce and Chantilly cream. 

 Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or discovering Farraddays for the first time, this limited-time Dine Out Lauderdale menu offers a distinctive taste of our award-worthy cuisine, warm hospitality, and upscale steakhouse atmosphere. Join us and discover why Farraddays Steakhouse remains one of Pompano's premier dining destinations.

ftl-23938.description: Experience the vibrant flavors and traditions of Brazil at Fogo de Chão, an upscale Brazilian steakhouse in the heart of downtown Fort Lauderdale on Las Olas Boulevard. Signature churrasco cuts are fire-roasted over an open flame and carved tableside by skilled gaucho chefs, complemented by an abundant Market Table featuring seasonal salads, imported cheeses, charcuterie and fresh vegetables. The stylish dining room features soaring wine displays, dry-aged meat lockers, an open churrasco grill and covered outdoor patios, while Bar Fogo offers Brazilian-inspired cocktails, South American wines and all-day happy hour. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, enjoying a business lunch or gathering with friends, Fogo de Chão delivers an authentic Brazilian dining experience in one of Greater Fort Lauderdale's premier culinary destinations.

ftl-24074.description:
Nestled along the Intracoastal Waterway, G&B Dockside brings a vibrant, coastal energy to Fort Lauderdale's dining scene. As the newest concept from Be Nice Restaurant Group, this highly anticipated waterfront destination takes a signature premium raw bar and seafood program and elevates it within a sleek, sophisticated setting. 

 Guests are invited to embrace a relaxed, social dining experience, pairing thoughtfully crafted, shareable plates with refreshing botanical cocktails while taking in sweeping waterfront views. Whether you are pulling up by boat for a lively, sun-soaked afternoon bite or settling in to experience the restaurant's buzzing, upscale dinner atmosphere as the sun goes down, G&B Dockside delivers a warm, refined approach to true South Florida living.

ftl-24003.description:
il Mulino Fort Lauderdale  brings the timeless flavors of Italy to Dine Out Lauderdale 2026 with an all-day, three-course menu for $45 — and every guest is welcomed with  a complimentary glass of house wine  or  The Tom Martini, one of our signature cocktails  crafted with Gulf Stream Distillery vodka. 

 il Mulino has been family-owned and operated since 1987, serving Fort Lauderdale from a kitchen built on recipes three generations deep. House-made pastas, classic dishes done properly, and a warm, intimate room have made it a neighborhood institution — the place friends and families return to, year after year. 

 That philosophy shines in this year's Dine Out Lauderdale menu. The centerpiece is the  Turner New Zealand Beef Tenderloin, featuring Turner's 100% grass-fed beef  — prized for its rich, clean flavor and exceptional tenderness. It is served with truffle mashed potatoes and asparagus, finished with a Port wine mushroom and gorgonzola sauce. 

 The meal opens with a choice of starters: the Traditional Caesar Salad with Parmigiano and toasted breadcrumbs, the signature Velvet Shrimp — lightly battered and finished in a rich scampi butter sauce — or a comforting bowl of Pasta e Fagioli or Minestrone. Alongside the tenderloin, guests may choose from a selection of petite entrées featuring  il Mulino favorites: Chicken Parmigiana  with spaghetti marinara,  Oven Baked Lasagna  layered with Bolognese and béchamel, or  Blackened Grilled Salmon  with truffle mashed potatoes and sautéed broccoli. 

 Dessert closes the evening the Italian way: house-made Tiramisu with espresso, Kahlúa, and imported mascarpone, or the Affogato — vanilla gelato crowned with double espresso and whipped cream. 

 Available all day throughout Dine Out Lauderdale, il Mulino's $45 menu is an invitation to experience la dolce vita. 
 
Reservations recommended.

ftl-23629.description: Jaxson's, a beloved South Florida institution established in 1956 by Monroe Udell, continues to be family-owned and operated. Renowned for its exceptional food and ice cream, Jaxson's uses only the finest ingredients in all its products, from food to soda syrups and toppings. The restaurant's unique décor features a vast collection of antiques and vintage decorations, including a captivating display of license plates dating back to 1911. The on-site country store offers a nostalgic selection of items. Experience the taste of South Florida at Jaxson's, where quality food and ice cream have been delighting customers for generations.

ftl-23631.description:
Discover one of Broward County’s most beloved dining destinations during Dine Out Lauderdale 2026. For over 25 years, Le Bistro has delighted locals and visitors alike with classic French cuisine, gracious hospitality, and an intimate atmosphere that makes every evening feel like a special occasion.  

   

  Voted Best Restaurant in North Broward by the  South Florida Sun Sentinel , Le Bistro is a critically acclaimed boutique restaurant known for its refined yet welcoming approach to dining. Candlelit tables, attentive service, and an exceptional wine selection create the perfect setting for romantic evenings, celebrations, and memorable nights out with family and friends.  

   

  Chef and owner Andy Trousdale continues a tradition of timeless French cooking inspired by the finest seasonal ingredients. Signature dishes such as Beef Wellington, Dover Sole, Faroe Island Salmon, Rack of Lamb, Steak Diane, Escargots, and house-made desserts have earned Le Bistro a loyal following throughout South Florida. Nightly specials and thoughtfully selected wines complement the menu, providing guests with a truly memorable dining experience.  

   

  During Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, guests are invited to enjoy a specially curated prix fixe menu showcasing some of Le Bistro’s favorite creations. Whether it’s your first visit or you are returning to a longtime favorite, Dine Out Lauderdale offers the perfect opportunity to experience the warmth, charm, and culinary excellence that have made Le Bistro a destination restaurant since 2001.  

   

  Located in the heart of Lighthouse Point, Le Bistro offers an elegant yet relaxed atmosphere where guests are encouraged to linger over great food, fine wine, and conversation. From anniversaries and birthdays to spontaneous date nights, every meal is designed to celebrate the pleasures of classic French dining.  

   

  Reserve at Le Bistro during Dine Out Lauderdale 2026 and discover why Le Bistro has remained one of South Florida’s favorite neighborhood gems for more than two decades.  

   

  Le Bistro  

  4520 N. Federal Highway  

  Lighthouse Point, Florida 33064  

   (954) 946-9240

ftl-23849.description: Mama Chea Café  is a family-owned, plant-based café in Davie dedicated to creating wholesome food that nourishes both people and the planet. Inspired by family recipes and a passion for healthy living, the café offers a vibrant menu of organic, vegan, gluten-free, and soy-free dishes made fresh daily. Guests can enjoy flavorful wraps, bowls, smoothies, cold-pressed juices, wellness shots, vegan soft serve, and house-made specialty products in a welcoming, community-focused atmosphere. Whether you're stopping in for a nutritious meal, a refreshing drink, or exploring their locally crafted market items, Mama Chea Café delivers a delicious and sustainable dining experience for every lifestyle.

ftl-23834.description: Moxies is one of the best restaurants in Fort Lauderdale, located on E Las Olas Blvd. Offering a trendy and lively atmosphere, our two-level modern restaurant boasts a globally inspired menu, serving freshly made dishes perfect for all occasions: lunch, dinner, Happy Hour, late-night eats, or weekend brunch. With indoor-outdoor bars on both levels, a spacious covered patio, and plenty of TVs, Moxies is the place to catch sporting events or enjoy Happy Hour in Fort Lauderdale. Indulge in our handcrafted cocktails and extensive wine list, which features half-priced bottles every Wednesday. Our restaurant can also host large group dining events, like bachelorettes, birthdays, and corporate events, and offers a private space on the 2nd level.

Negroni Weston is where exceptional dining, handcrafted cocktails, and a lively atmosphere come together. Inspired by flavors from around the world, our menu offers everything from fresh sushi and premium steaks to signature pastas and creative cocktails, making every visit a memorable experience.

Join us during Dine Out Lauderdale and discover why Negroni is one of South Florida’s favorite dining destinations. Beyond our seasonal menus, we offer something special every week:

• Sunday Brunch Buffet | All You Can Eat | 11 AM – 4 PM | $34.50
• Happy Hour Daily | 3 PM – 7 PM
• Monday – Wine Night
• Tuesday – 2-for-1 Sushi
• Thursday – Karaoke Night
• Friday & Saturday – Live DJ | 7 PM – 11 PM

Whether you’re joining us for a casual lunch, date night, happy hour, or weekend brunch, there’s always a reason to come back to Negroni Weston.

ftl-23797.description:
Patio Bar & Pizza is proud to participate in Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, Greater Fort Lauderdale’s premier annual culinary celebration. 
 Located in the heart of Fort Lauderdale’s Flagler Village, Patio Bar & Pizza is offering a special $45 prix fixe dinner menu per person, available Tuesday through Sunday.  
 This vibrant patio bar and pizza spot blends the comfort of a neighborhood bar with the energy of a modern sports bar in a stylish indoor-outdoor setting. Savor signature brick-oven pizza, oven-fired wings, and shareable plates, paired with craft cocktails, local and imported beers, fine wines, and premium spirits, making us a go-to wine bar in Fort Lauderdale, FL. Whether you’re here for happy hour until 7 PM, game day, or outdoor dining in Fort Lauderdale, FL, Patio Bar & Pizza delivers great food, drinks, and unforgettable vibes. 
 Reservations are encouraged. 
 Visit  www.patiobarpizza.com  for more information.

ftl-23933.description: Red Sea Restaurant brings the vibrant flavors of Ethiopian and East African cuisine to Fort Lauderdale, offering guests a warm, communal dining experience centered around traditional dishes and authentic preparation. ftl-23829.description: Rodizio Grill, located at Dania Pointe, offers a distinctive Brazilian steakhouse experience to the Greater Fort Lauderdale community. Enjoy an all-you-can-eat gourmet salad bar and authentic side dishes, complemented by unlimited rotisserie-grilled meats carved tableside by skilled gauchos.

items.name: Full Rodizo Experience
items.description: Experience Rodizio Grill's authentic Brazilian steakhouse rotisserie-grilled meats carved by our Gauchos. Rotisserie-grilled meats include: authentic Brazilian churrasco favorites such as picanha (Brazil's signature top sirloin), tri-tip sirloin, beef tender, glazed ham, parmesan garlic chicken, sweet and spicy chicken, bacon-wrapped chicken, Brazilian sausage, Brazilian favorite chicken hearts, lamb, and our famous grilled pineapple. Our Gauchos carve these meats tableside throughout your dining experience, creating the authentic Brazilian steakhouse experience for which Rodizio Grill is known.

ftl-23672.description:
Experience the flavors of Southern Italy during Dine Out Lauderdale at Sicilian Oven, where handcrafted cuisine, warm hospitality, and a vibrant atmosphere come together for an unforgettable dining experience. 

 Known for its authentic wood-fired pizzas, house-made specialties, fresh ingredients, and inviting ambiance, Sicilian Oven offers guests a modern take on traditional Italian dining. Whether you're joining us for a casual lunch, a date night, a family gathering, or a night out with friends, our Dine Out Lauderdale menus provide the perfect opportunity to explore some of our most-loved dishes at exceptional value. 

 Guests can enjoy a specially curated  $35 Lunch Experience , featuring an appetizer, entrée, dessert, and a glass of wine, or indulge in our  $45 Dinner Experience , which includes two appetizers, one entrée, one dessert and a glass of wine. Each menu has been thoughtfully designed to showcase the bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and signature recipes that have made Sicilian Oven a South Florida favorite. 

 Looking to make your visit even better? Pair your Dine Out Lauderdale experience with our popular weekly happenings. Guests can enjoy  BOGO Beer Tuesdays ,  50% Off Bottled Wine Wednesdays ,  $10 Specialty Cocktails on Thirsty Thursdays , and  Happy Hour Monday through Friday from 11:30 AM to 7:00 PM , featuring drink specials and Bar Bites from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Eligible Dine Out Lauderdale offers can be combined with these promotions, making Sicilian Oven one of the best dining values in South Florida throughout Restaurant Months. 

 From our famous wood-fired pizzas and handcrafted pastas to fresh salads, shareable appetizers, and decadent desserts, every dish is prepared with passion and inspired by generations of Italian culinary tradition. Whether you're enjoying lunch with a complimentary glass of wine or taking advantage of one of our weekly beverage specials, every visit is designed to bring people together around great food and exceptional hospitality. 

 With a welcoming atmosphere, a full-service bar, and a commitment to quality, Sicilian Oven offers more than just a meal—it's an experience centered around sharing great food and creating memorable moments around the table. 

 Dine Out Lauderdale is available at participating Sicilian Oven locations in Lighthouse Point, Fort Lauderdale, Plantation, Cooper City, and Coral Springs from  August 1 through September 30 . 

 Join us and discover why there's never been a better time to experience Sicilian Oven. 

  Salute! Terms and conditions apply.

ftl-23821.description:
Celebrate the flavors of South Florida during  Dine Out Lauderdale  at  Steelpan , the signature restaurant located inside  Sonesta Fort Lauderdale Beach . Inspired by the vibrant culinary traditions of the Caribbean and the relaxed elegance of oceanfront dining, Steelpan offers a unique dining experience that combines fresh, locally sourced ingredients with bold island flavors. 

 Our exclusive Dine Out Lauderdale prix-fixe menu has been thoughtfully curated to showcase the restaurant's distinctive approach to coastal cuisine. Guests can enjoy a selection of handcrafted appetizers, flavorful entrées featuring fresh seafood, premium meats, and seasonal ingredients, followed by indulgent desserts that provide the perfect finishing touch to an unforgettable meal. 

 Whether you're a local looking to explore Fort Lauderdale's celebrated dining scene or a visitor seeking an authentic taste of the destination, Steelpan offers the perfect setting. Enjoy views of Fort Lauderdale Beach, warm hospitality, handcrafted cocktails, and a welcoming atmosphere create an experience that is as memorable as the cuisine itself. 

 Join us for Dine Out Lauderdale and discover why Steelpan has become a favorite destination for contemporary Caribbean-inspired dining. Every dish is crafted with passion, every ingredient selected with care, and every visit is an invitation to relax, connect, and savor the flavors of the coast.

ftl-23682.description:
Welcome to S3, a premier Fort Lauderdale beach restaurant where ocean views, coastal cuisine, and laid-back elegance come together.  Opened in May 2013, S3—where sun, surf and sand uniquely fuse with steak, seafood, and sushi—has since taken Fort Lauderdale beach by storm. As a top Fort Lauderdale beach restaurant, S3 offers an upscale, casual-chic vibe in a trendy, laid-back atmosphere. This scintillating seaside endeavor provides the ultimate in oceanfront dining, offering an eclectic array of indoor/outdoor seating, all surrounded by breathtaking views of the Atlantic and Fort Lauderdale beach. 

 Featuring a menu centered on coastal cuisine and a unique sharable concept, S3 serves the freshest daily catches and premium cuts of meat, with locally-sourced and seasonal offerings, and an expansive, one-of-a-kind sushi bar to complement, open seven days a week serving lunch, dinner, and Sunday brunch. Whether your joining us for cocktails or a business lunch, a celebratory meal or leisurely brunch, our team looks forward to serving you.

ftl-24001.description:
At Cook and The Cork, Chef Keith Blauschild's cooking is difficult to put in a single category—and that's exactly the point. Rather than following a particular cuisine or chasing the latest trend, he cooks whatever inspires him, blending classic techniques with influences from around the world to create dishes that are distinctly his own. His philosophy is simple: make food people genuinely want to come back for. The result is a dining experience that is eclectic, approachable, and unmistakably his own. 

 The experience extends well beyond the kitchen. The Cook and The Cork has earned Wine Spectator's Award of Excellence for 12 consecutive years, with a wine program featuring selections from around the world, more than 30 wines by the glass, and one of South Florida's most diverse sake collections. A full bar, led by talented bartenders with a knack for inventive cocktails, rounds out the experience.

ftl-24086.description:
Nestled within the natural beauty of Hugh Taylor Birch State Park in Fort Lauderdale,  The Grill at The Grove  offers a unique waterfront dining experience where great food, refreshing drinks, and stunning scenery come together. Surrounded by lush tropical landscapes and just steps from the beach, this hidden oasis is the perfect destination for locals and visitors looking to relax and unwind. 

 The Grill features a diverse menu with something for every taste, including handcrafted sandwiches, crisp salads & bowls, shareable appetizers, and beach-inspired cocktails. Guests can enjoy casual outdoor dining with beautiful ocean views, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere that captures the essence of South Florida living. 

 Whether you're fueling up after a bike ride, paddleboarding adventure, or a day at the beach, The Grill at The Grove provides the perfect place to eat, drink, and connect with nature. With its welcoming ambiance, scenic surroundings, and flavorful menu, it has quickly become one of Fort Lauderdale’s favorite hidden gems.

ftl-23607.description:
The Wagyu House by Meat N’ Bone is a modern steakhouse built around exceptional sourcing, premium proteins, and an approachable, memorable dining experience. Located in Hallandale Beach, the restaurant brings Meat N’ Bone’s expertise in world-class beef to the table, offering guests a best-in-class steakhouse experience with options for every taste, occasion, and budget. 

 The Wagyu House is designed for guests who appreciate great steak, whether they are looking for a classic cut, a premium steakhouse favorite, or a rare Wagyu experience. The menu showcases a thoughtful lineup of beef selections, including approachable steak options, elevated USDA Prime cuts, domestic Wagyu, and highly marbled Japanese A5 Wagyu. This range allows guests to explore different levels of marbling, flavor, and richness while enjoying the quality and hospitality that define the Meat N’ Bone experience. 

 At its core, The Wagyu House makes exceptional steak more accessible without compromising on quality. Guests can enjoy a refined meal that fits their preference and price point, from a perfectly cooked steak dinner to an indulgent tasting-style experience built around some of the finest beef in the world. Beyond steak, the restaurant also offers a curated selection of appetizers, sides, seafood, and desserts that complement the main experience and create a complete steakhouse meal. 

 With warm service, a polished atmosphere, and a menu rooted in sourcing and craftsmanship, The Wagyu House offers a steakhouse experience that feels both elevated and approachable. Whether guests are visiting for a casual dinner, date night, celebration, business meal, or a special occasion, The Wagyu House delivers a distinctive dining experience centered on great beef, bold flavors, and genuine hospitality.

ftl-24118.description:
Step inside a legendary piece of Fort Lauderdale history at  The Wreck Bar , nestled inside the iconic B Ocean Resort. Designed to resemble a Spanish galleon shipwreck with dark wood paneling and vintage nautical decor, this historic destination has captivated guests since the 1950s. As you dine on chef-curated coastal cuisine and sip handcrafted tropical cocktails, peek through the underwater porthole windows directly into the pool to catch mesmerizing live mermaid sightings and performances unlike anywhere else in the world. 

 During  Dine Out Lauderdale , elevate your evening with exclusive multi-course menu offerings while taking in South Florida’s most unique dining spectacle. Whether you’re stopping in for early evening drinks or taking in one of our signature mermaid sightings, shows or underwater burlesque performance, The Wreck Bar promises an unforgettable night out on Fort Lauderdale Beach.

ftl-23728.description:
TIMBR Restaurant & Lounge is proud to participate in Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, offering guests a special $60 three-course prix fixe menu available for a limited time during Dine Out Lauderdale Restaurant Months. 

 Located at 15 W Las Olas Blvd in the heart of Fort Lauderdale, TIMBR invites diners to experience its modern American menu, warm hospitality, and beautifully designed dining spaces through a curated three-course menu created exclusively for the occasion. From elevated seasonal flavors to signature TIMBR style, this limited-time offering is the perfect way to discover one of Fort Lauderdale’s most distinctive dining destinations. 

 This exceptional restaurant boasts two unique dining rooms: The Parc Dining Room, adorned with trees creating a modern and natural ambiance, and The Atrium, ensconced with flowers and a glass pyramid atop the 33' ceiling. 

 TIMBR's "Vineyard Cuisine" menu features a fusion of elevated familiar dishes from Modern American favorites to European classics, complemented by our extensive wine list and distinctive craft cocktail menu elevating every meal. TIMBR is where tradition and innovation converge, offering a full-sensory, enchanted, unforgettable, experience.

Experience the vibrant flavors of coastal Italy at Timpano Las Olas, where timeless Italian cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, and sophisticated hospitality come together in the heart of Fort Lauderdale. Located along the iconic Las Olas Boulevard, Timpano invites guests to gather for an elevated evening dining experience that blends modern elegance with classic Italian traditions. 

 As part of Dine Out Lauderdale 2026, guests are invited to enjoy a specially curated three-course dinner menu for $60 per person. Begin with a choice of appetizers including Semolina Dusted Calamari, Arancini alla Siciliana, or a fresh Butter Lettuce Salad. For the main course, select from signature favorites such as Fettuccine alla Vodka, Pork Chop Florentina, or Chicken Marsala, each showcasing the restaurant’s commitment to authentic flavors and quality ingredients. End the evening on a sweet note with a choice of Seasonal Gelato or classic Tiramisu. 

 Whether discovering Timpano for the first time or returning for a favorite Italian tradition, guests can look forward to a memorable night on Las Olas filled with exceptional flavors, warm hospitality, and a taste of Italy’s enduring culinary heritage.

ftl-23601.description:
Experience Dine Out Fort Lauderdale at Truluck’s, where exceptional seafood, prime steaks, attentive hospitality, and coastal elegance come together just steps from the beach. 

 For this limited-time promotion, Truluck’s Fort Lauderdale is offering a special multi-course prix fixe experience for $60 per person, inspired by our Summer of ’92 menu. Designed to showcase signature Truluck’s flavor and hospitality, the menu features a thoughtfully curated selection of starters, entrées, and desserts, giving guests the opportunity to enjoy a complete dining experience at an exceptional value. 

 For the first course, diners can select from a variety of menu options, with standouts including the Little Gem Caesar Salad, Shrimp Cocktail, or available for upgrade, the Burrata & Stone Fruit Salad, featuring shaved prosciutto, honey vinaigrette, and crushed pistachios. 

 Following starters, guests will choose from entrée options including the Petit Scallop & Shrimp Sauté, a 6-oz. Filet Mignon, or Pappardelle Bolognese. To complete the experience, diners can select a sweet finish, including Petit Carrot Cake, Petit Chocolate Malt Cake, Petit Key Lime Pie, or the seasonal Citrusmisu, featuring citrus mascarpone, soaked ladyfingers, and basil-scented strawberries. 

 Located on Fort Lauderdale Beach, Truluck’s offers a sophisticated setting for a memorable evening out, whether you are celebrating a special occasion, gathering with friends, enjoying a date night, or simply savoring the best of the season. Guests can expect the fresh seafood and impeccable service Truluck’s is known for, along with the warm, polished atmosphere that makes every visit feel like an occasion. 

 Join us during Dine Out Fort Lauderdale and enjoy a multi-course prix fixe experience for $60 at Truluck’s on the beach.

ftl-23870.description:
Located in the heart of Wilton Manors on iconic Wilton Drive, Tulio’s Tacos & Tequila Bar brings together bold Mexican flavors, handcrafted margaritas, upbeat energy, and a stylish, social atmosphere. 

 It’s the kind of place made for margaritas with friends, casual taco date nights, weekend brunch celebrations, and lively group dinners. Guests can also enjoy bottomless brunch every weekend, Margarita Monday, Taco Tuesday, Wine Down Wednesday, and Fiesta Hour specials from 5:00 to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday. The kitchen stays open until midnight all week long, making Tulio’s an easy go-to for dinner, drinks, and late-night bites on the Drive. 

  Dine Out Lauderdale 2026  
Tulio’s is excited to return to Dine Out Lauderdale with a specially curated three-course dinner menu for $45 per person. Available seven days a week from August 1 through September 30, 2026, the menu gives guests the perfect excuse to sip, savor, and experience a taste of Tulio’s.

 Whether you're discovering Union Kitchen & Bar for the first time or returning for another memorable evening, DineOut Lauderdale is the perfect opportunity to experience our kitchen at its best. 

 Reservations are recommended.

ftl-23812.description: Worthwyld is Fort Lauderdale's destination for  Food Uncompromised™ —where clean ingredients, bold flavors, and chef-driven cuisine come together in a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere. Located on Las Olas Boulevard, Worthwyld serves breakfast, lunch, dinner, happy hour, weekend brunch, and handcrafted cocktails, with every dish made fresh to order using whole, thoughtfully sourced ingredients. The kitchen is committed to preparing food without seed oils, fryers or microwaves, proving that better for you dining can be both indulgent and satisfying. From signature grain bowls, fresh salads, and grilled proteins to burgers, smoothies, and an innovative cocktail program, the menu offers something for every lifestyle and occasion. Whether you're grabbing a quick lunch, meeting friends for happy hour, or enjoying a relaxed dinner, Worthwyld delivers an elevated dining experience where exceptional flavor and uncompromising quality are always on the menu.

Aurora at the Celeste offers modern American cuisine with an emphasis on fresh, locally sourced food and the inspiring culinary genius of Executive  Chef Mike Trudnak .  
  Aurora is a glimmering spectacle within the Celeste Hotel experience. Come experience this beautiful restaurant located inside of the Celeste Hotel on campus at UCF. In turn, we know that true beauty can be found when people from all walks of life come together under one roof for a shared purpose.  
  This is the spirit of Aurora at the Celeste. We believe wonder is created in the midst of communal experiences, particularly over a shared love for delicious food and captivating atmosphere. An immersive concept set apart from all others in Orlando, Aurora is a restaurant experience that captures vast attention through colorful flavors, stunning ambiance, and refined service and you’re sure to have an out of this world experience.

orl-53373.description:
Located in Winter Park, AVA MediterrAegean is a multi-sensory venue that seamlessly blends dining and pleasure in a refined and spirited atmosphere. Meaning life, water, island, and bird in Greek, AVA MediterrAegean is a celebration of splendor, freedom, escapism, and joy. Here, genuine hospitality, delectable food, and a vibrant atmosphere combine to entertain the senses and transport you to a place of nightly celebration. 
 Our menu, crafted from the freshest ingredients and purest cooking techniques, highlights the aromas of the earth with exotic spices, fragrant herbs, lemons, olive oil, rose water, orange peel, dried fruits and nuts, fresh produce, and premium proteins. 
 Experience exceptional service and culinary excellence with Magical Dining, available daily during dinner service. Enjoy our Golden Hour offerings daily from 5 pm to 6 pm, and our special brunch menu every Saturday and Sunday from 11:30 am to 3:00 pm.

orl-49088.description:
Bites & Bubbles in the heart of the Mills 50 District of Downtown Orlando, is an American Restaurant with a French Kiss! Bubbles is the theme with bubble glass chandeliers throughout, "effervescent" walls and an expansive bar with 60's music playing in the background. The concept and the menu are the brainchild of Eddie Nickell and Nicholas Olivieri.  
  Our menu changes often, depending on what we can get in fresh for the day, and mainly has influences of French cooking along with some traditional American recipes and even some Italian favorites with an extensive wine menu.  
   
   We will be closed on Monday, September 1st, in observance of Labor Day.

Orlando's premier Turkish dining experience will have you wondering when you arrived in Turkey! 
 Our focus is Anatolian cuisine – we have a wonderful variety of fresh salads, hand carved Halal meats, made to order breads and pides. We offer Turkish Cuisine at its finest, exquisitely prepared and served in a warm authentic Turkish atmosphere. There are beef ribs, filet mignon, sausages, and yes, PICANHA. But it’s not just steakhouse classics here, fresh options include seasonal salads, cheeses and delicious hot dishes. Dinner includes cheese bread and fried plantains which are brought to your table.

orl-55451.description:
Sharing a one-of-a-kind experience, now in Orlando   
 Chima Steakhouse, named after chimarrao, a traditional drink of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, that symbolizes hospitality and friendship-certainly lives up to its name. 
 Chima combines traditional Brazilian rodizio and excellent service with an elegant setting. Guests enjoy a unique, family-friendly dining experience suitable for a variety of occasions, boasting a diverse set of menu offerings appealing to a wide range of tastes, palates, and dietary preferences. 
 Gauchos roam the dining room with skewers of meat (top sirloin, filet mignon, ribeye, lamb chops, chicken, salmon, shrimp, and more), and once you are ready to start your Chima experience, simply flip the token to the “yes” side and let the show begin! 
 The VIP room may be reserved for special social events as well as for corporate events and meetings. Cable and wireless A/V connectivity available. Visit our website to request booking information.

orl-58950.description:
Daniel Gabor’s is a chef-driven restaurant built around thoughtful cooking, bold flavors, and warm hospitality. The menu is inspired by seasonality, quality ingredients, and a creative low-waste approach, turning both familiar favorites and overlooked ingredients into dishes that feel modern, generous, and memorable. 
 From braised short rib and flamed chorizo mussels to grass-fed burgers, fresh seafood, and deeply comforting onion soup, the food is designed to be approachable while still feeling refined. Every dish is created with intention, focusing on strong technique, honest flavors, and the kind of details that make a meal feel special. 
 The restaurant offers a relaxed yet elevated dining experience, where guests can enjoy thoughtful plates, quality meats and seafood, house-made elements, and warm service in a welcoming modern setting.

Welcome to Fogo de Chão® (fo-go dèe shoun), an authentic Brazilian steakhouse. In 1979, Fogo® began sharing the gaucho way of preparing meat in Porto Alegre, Brazil. Today, our gaucho chefs still expertly grill each of our 16 cuts of meat and offer you continuous tableside service. We invite you to enjoy the delicious preparations of our gaucho chefs along with our gourmet salad bar, authentic Brazilian side dishes, and award-winning wine list. 
 
Located on International Drive in the heart of the city's renowned visitor corridor, the  Orlando Fogo de Chão  is a convenient destination for locals or guests of the Orange County Convention Center.

 From signature cocktails that transport you to the islands to standout plates that celebrate the best of Caribbean-Cuban cuisine, Harry’s Poolside Bar & Grill promises a memorable dining experience filled with flavor, warmth, and laid-back elegance. 

 Perfect for couples, families, and friends seeking a touch of tropical magic right in the heart of Orlando. Reservations recommended.

orl-58552.description:
Lizzy’s Live is a vibrant supper club and live music destination located in the heart of Orlando’s Restaurant Row. Blending globally inspired small plates, craft cocktails, and high-energy entertainment, the venue delivers a full night-out experience in one stylish, intimate setting. Guests can enjoy live bands and DJs spanning genres including jazz, R&B, Latin, Top 40, and dance music, making it a favorite for both locals and visitors seeking authentic Orlando nightlife.  
  Designed to transition seamlessly from dinner to late-night entertainment, Lizzy’s Live offers table service dining, a full bar, and a trendy yet welcoming atmosphere ideal for date nights, group outings, and celebrations. The venue also hosts private events and corporate gatherings, offering a unique alternative to traditional event spaces.  
  Whether stopping in for cocktails, live music, or a full supper club experience, Lizzy’s Live brings together food, entertainment, and nightlife into one unforgettable Orlando destination.

WHERE EVERYONE IS FAMILY!   

 At Mama's, authentic Italian cooking makes you feel right at home. Take a seat and enjoy a menu of Italian-inspired dishes from Tuscany, Naples, and Piemonte, along with house specialties like Insalata Mama Della and the best lasagna this side of Sicily. Complement your meal with a selection from our extensive wine list and save some room for coffee, tiramisu, and cannoli. 

 You’ll find Mama Della’s Ristorante on the Harbor Piazza at Loews Portofino Bay Hotel at Universal Orlando, but you’ll feel like you’ve been carried away to the famous seaside village of Portofino, Italy. 

 Entertainment includes live music and opera singers. Open daily for dinner only.

orl-49070.description:
Mia’s Italian Kitchen is rooted in family inspired by one of the partner’s unique relationship with his great-grandmother - she didn’t speak a word of English, so they communicated through food. Originally from Naples, Italy, she used simplistic raw ingredients - an approach that Mia’s carried over to their own menu, which includes house-made pasta, Italian sandwiches, charcuterie, and square pizzas. 
 Mia’s is a beautiful and unique restaurant and event venue for groups of up to 500 guests. Mia's offers elegantly appointed interiors with flexible layout options with a lively bar and a pizza station from which our delicious and unique square pizzas are made. Also, it features a soaring ceiling, adorned with custom printed murals. 
 Our talented culinary team, led by Regional Executive Chef Brandon Whitestone, has created a variety of delicious, made-from-scratch menus. Options range from delicious hors d’oeuvres to hearty custom buffets, and multi-course plated meals.

orl-58971.description:
Mordisco Steakhouse brings the vibrant flavors, traditions and hospitality of Latin America and the Caribbean to Orlando’s International Drive. The restaurant celebrates the art of gathering around great food through authentic recipes, premium ingredients and time-honored cooking techniques.  
  At the heart of the experience is Mordisco’s signature Carne en Vara, a traditional Venezuelan method of slow-roasting premium cuts of meat over an open wood fire, creating the rich, smoky flavors that define the restaurant. Guests can also enjoy award-winning ceviche, handcrafted arepas and fresh seafood, alongside an extensive beverage program featuring handcrafted cocktails, premium spirits and curated wines.  
  With a lively atmosphere, indoor and outdoor dining, happy hour specials and a focus on genuine hospitality, Mordisco offers a memorable dining experience that brings people together through food, culture and celebration.

mosonori is the latest creation from Chef Henry Moso, the culinary genius behind the renowned Kabooki Sushi. With his passion for innovative Japanese cuisine and commitment to excellence, Chef Moso has crafted a unique dining experience that celebrates the delicate balance of flavors and textures in each hand roll.  
  Step into our elegantly designed space, where minimalist decor featuring clean lines, natural materials, and touches of indigo blue create a serene atmosphere. At the heart of mosonori is our inviting island bar, where you can witness our skilled chefs craft each hand roll with precision and care.  
  Our menu showcases a harmonious blend of traditional Japanese flavors and innovative twists. From classic favorites like salmon and tuna to seasonal specialties featuring dry-aged fish and gourmet ingredients, each hand roll is a testament to our commitment to quality and flavor.

orl-59066.description: Palma Italian Kitchen brings a fresh Florida twist to classic Italian cuisine in the heart of ChampionsGate. The menu blends traditional Italian favorites with creative local influences, offering something for every guest. Start with the popular Italian nachos, a unique take on a familiar favorite, then explore a variety of handcrafted pizzas made with quality ingredients and bold flavors. Beyond pizzas and pasta, the menu features appetizers, salads, sandwiches, and signature dishes designed to satisfy both casual diners and food enthusiasts. Whether you're gathering with family, meeting friends, or enjoying a relaxed meal after a day of exploring Central Florida, Palma Italian Kitchen delivers a welcoming atmosphere and memorable dining experience. With its combination of authentic Italian inspiration, fresh ingredients, and Florida flair, Palma Italian Kitchen has become a favorite destination for residents and visitors seeking delicious food, warm hospitality, and flavors that keep them coming back.

orl-58941.description: Papparella Trattoria is a third-generation Italian family restaurant with more than 43 years of history, rooted in Calabria, Italy, and built on recipes passed down through the Cardoso family. Today, Papparella operates eight restaurants in Brazil and one in Orlando, with an ongoing expansion project in the United States. The concept brings classic Italian hospitality, naturally fermented pizza dough, wood-fired techniques, handmade-style pastas, premium ingredients, curated wines, and a warm trattoria atmosphere to Dr. Phillips. Recognized with Pizza DOC quality certification, Papparella is known for authentic flavors, family recipes, and a dining experience that feels both refined and welcoming. From traditional pizzas and burrata to signature pastas, seafood, and tableside-style hospitality, Papparella offers guests a true Italian experience shaped by generations of passion, craftsmanship, and family tradition.

orl-59069.description:
Pisco Peruvian Gastrobar is a vibrant celebration of Peru’s bold spirit and rich culinary heritage, brought to life through modern technique and unapologetic flavor. Every dish is a reflection of tradition elevated—bright, fresh ceviches, sizzling anticuchos, and thoughtfully crafted signature plates that honor the depth and diversity of Peruvian cuisine.  
  At Pisco, dining is more than a meal—it’s an experience full of energy, color, and connection. The space hums with a lively, social atmosphere where craft cocktails flow, music sets the tone, and every plate is designed to be shared and remembered. From the first bite to the last sip, guests are immersed in a journey that feels both authentic and excitingly contemporary.  
  As part of Visit Orlando’s Magical Dining, Pisco invites guests to indulge in a specially curated prix fixe menu that showcases its most iconic flavors and passionate culinary storytelling.

orl-49046.description:
Primo Restaurant celebrates Chef Melissa Kelly’s flavorful Puglian heritage and combines sensibilities within the overarching design narrative. The redesigned space of textural and tonal architecture brings forth Primo’s notion of being  stewards of the land  serving seasonally fresh and locally-sourced Mediterranean-inspired dishes. 
  Two-time James Beard Award-winning Chef Melissa Kelly grew up on Long Island and spent countless hours in her Italian grandmother’s kitchen, paying close attention to every detail in the flavors of her Southern Italy coastal Puglian heritage. This is where her love of Mediterranean foods took hold. 
  PRIMO AT JW MARRIOTT  • Forbes Travel Guide – Four Stars (2026) • AAA Four Diamond – (2026) • MICHELIN Guide Florida – MICHELIN Recommended (2026) • Wine Spectator — One Cup Award of Excellence (2026)

Reggiano’s of Celebration is situated in the Town Center of Celebration. Our outdoor enclosed patio overlooks the picturesque Lake Rianhard. The restaurant’s location attracts visitors both locally and from all over who seek an elevated dining experience. 

 Our impressive open kitchen atmosphere and wood burning oven paired with Authentic Italian Cuisine, Gourmet Wood fired Pizza, Fresh Fish, Steaks and Chops. Our excellent wine menu features a selection of fine wines, from reasonable to high-end. Or choose from a refreshing list of specialty cocktails, beers and spirits. orl-53568.description:
Established in 1995, Rodizio Grill was the first Brazilian “churrasco” steakhouse in the United States. More than twenty-five years later, the brand remains known for its playful Brazilian spirit, authentic menu offerings and family-friendly atmosphere. 
 
The unique concept features over a dozen rotisserie-grilled items expertly seasoned and carved tableside by traditionally dressed Gauchos. While the meats are the main attraction, they are complemented with an award-winning gourmet salad bar, marked by original salads, fresh seasonal fruits and vegetables, and authentic hot side dishes. Rodizio proudly features an extensive wine list, signature cocktails, local & imported beer and homemade desserts.  
 
Located off International Drive, Rodizio Grill at Pointe Orlando is the epicenter of Orlando’s primary tourism district, just minutes from major theme parks and within walking distance of Orange County Convention Center.

Discover a vibrant fusion of Indian, Thai, and Chinese cuisine at Tamara Lake Mary, where authentic flavors and modern culinary craftsmanship come together in a warm, upscale setting. Our menu celebrates the rich spices of India, the fresh and balanced flavors of Thailand, and the comforting favorites of Chinese cuisine, creating a unique dining experience that offers something for every palate.

 Conveniently located in Park Place Plaza, Tamara Lake Mary invites guests to experience exceptional cuisine, attentive and hospitality.

orl-51911.description:
The Nauti Lobstah is a friend and family-owned restaurant offering an extensive variety of  Northeastern and New England seafood  in a friendly casual setting with a rich history in Apopka, Florida, located just 20 minutes from Downtown Orlando. 
 Named  Critic’s Choice Best Seafood in Orlando  by the Orlando Sentinel Foodie Awards. The menu features fresh Maine lobster,  4   LBS LAZY MAN’S LOBSTAH,  scrumptious Connecticut and New England style lobster rolls, freshly shucked East Coast oysters, fresh fish, Creekstone Premium Black Angus steaks, and more, all served with warm hospitality, earning a loyal local following. 
  “THE BIGGEST LOBSTER ROLL IN FLORIDA!”  2 FT roll stuffed with a whopping 2 pounds of Maine lobster is a destination meal for visitors from across the U.S.  
 Open for lunch and dinner, Tuesday - Saturday. Available for private events and groups. Vegan and gluten-free options available. Discover why The Nauti Lobstah is “YOUR Seafood Place!” 
  **Please be aware this restaurant operates on first come first serve basis only, and does not have a reservation system**

orl-55566.description:
Welcome to Wine 4 Oysters Bar & Bites, where our love for oysters isn't just a taste preference, it's a journey of culinary discovery! For 17 years, we've been exploring the globe, handpicking the most exquisite oysters, each reflecting the unique character of its homeland. 
 Our quest has taken us to: 
 The sophisticated shores of France, where oysters are dressed in a classic vinaigrette. 
 The mystical lands of Japan, home to miso-steamed oyster wonders. 
 The bustling bays of Sydney, Hong Kong, Oregon, Chesapeake Bay, New Orleans, and our very own sunshine state, Florida, each offering its distinct oyster flavors. 
 This voyage is far from over. Our enthusiasm drives us to constantly seek out new flavors, to dive into the diverse culinary stories each oyster region has to tell. 
 Whether you're joining us for an immersive dining experience or bringing a piece of our oyster haven into your home, we're here to provide.

az-avanti.description: A Tradition Since 1974 A valley tradition since 1974. Avanti is the recipient of many prestigious culinary awards. You are sure to enjoy every aspect of dining at Avanti; from the sophisticated decor and festive atmosphere, to the fabulous service - from the delectable, gourmet appetizers and entrees, to the wide selection of wines that will perfectly compliment your meal. Complete your evening with a decadent dessert and linger over a cappuccino. We make it easy to host your own party! Avanti provides incomparable catering services with a wide array of themes and menus. Angelo greets guests nightly and makes them feel welcomed into the warm, Italian atmosphere; sharing great food and laughter!

Located in the Heart of Buckeye Conveniently located in the heart of Buckeye, our restaurant provides a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere where you can enjoy delicious food with family and friends.

az-buck-rider-gilbert.description: At Buck & Rider, when you savor a briny oyster on the half-shell or tuck into a sushi roll at the bar, you can be sure what’s on your plate is impeccably fresh and thoughtfully sourced. Our team goes to extraordinary lengths to bring you the best ingredients. We take a mindful approach to sourcing, buying directly from small producers around the world who engage in sustainable fishing and oyster farming practices. We fly their catch into our kitchens every day. That means hand-picked Louisiana blue crab for our famous crab cakes and Ora King salmon in our sushi. The daily raw bar menu is time-stamped and continuously updated to reflect the freshness of our fish and availability of oysters from our fishermen and farmers. Our commitment to quality goes far beyond seafood. Steaks come from our special B&R Reserve beef program: USDA certified, aged, and cut to our specifications. Our cocktails follow the same ingredient-driven philosophy, made with hand-squeezed juices and premium spirits. Our guiding philosophy is simple: superior ingredients, perfectly executed. We let the finest, freshest ingredients speak for themselves. No fussy preparations, no stuffy atmosphere – just an inviting spot to enjoy the best our fishers and farmers have to offer, procured, prepared, and presented with care.

az-buck-rider.description: With sweeping views to the picturesque Camelback Mountain, Buck &Rider, a seafood and steak eatery, sits in the heart of Phoenix’s blossoming Arcadia neighborhood. Housed in an Australian-inspired dwelling, its rugged architecture nestles a sophisticatedly warm interior, anchored by a stone fireplace, that seamlessly opens its floor-to-ceiling glass-doors to the outdoors in a lush landscaped patio. Priding ourselves in utmost freshness and ingredients, our compelling seafood and steak dishes are chef-crafted with gusto, directly from farmers and fishermen of the East, West, and Gulf Coasts. Taking advantage of fishing conditions, we fly in our fish and seafood direct daily to your plate – a first in Arizona. Our steaks are of our own LGO-Reserve Beef, and paired beautifully with our expertly crafted cocktails, raw bar items, hand-rolled sushi, and farm-fresh vegetables. Come in and be our guest delighting all your senses, and start falling in love at your first bite…! Let our Lunch, Brunch, and Dinner menus be your expert guide.

So come right in! We look forward to serving you.

az-cobre-kitchen-cocktails.description: Located on the ground floor of Canopy by Hilton Scottsdale Old Town, Cobre Kitchen + Cocktails is an American brassiere inspired by the Southwest and features thoughtfully curated small and shareable plates highlighting local flavors. As the go-to neighborhood gathering spot for quality food and drink, the craft cocktail program offers a modern, yet familiar twist to the area’s thriving cocktail scene. Creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere, the restaurant and bar’s modern Southwest aesthetic embodies the vibrant and energetic persona of the surrounding city with floor-to-ceiling windows, dramatic arched wood ceilings, contemporary furnishings, sleek marble counter tops and subtle touches of copper throughout, harkening to the restaurant’s maiden roots.

az-culinary-dropout-gilbert.description: Leave your report cards and school books at home. From the chefs on the line with silver-studded ears and mohawk hairdo, to the inked-up, decked-out bar staff mixologists shaking and stirring some of the most creative cocktails, we’re all dropouts here. Culinary Dropout serves the very best in unique gastro-pub fare that quietly seeks out future musical venue superstars who wouldn’t mind being paid at the bar in whiskey and pretzel bites. We’re not easily definable and even harder to forget. And we did that on purpose so you could come and hang out. Spend time in our pub enjoying live music over brunch or happy hour. So seriously, come and hang out this weekend.

az-dolce-vita-gelato-and-grocery.description: Gelato and Grocery Dolce Vita is family owned and operated. Two Italian families are providing since more than 12 years the most authentic Italian experience you can find in Phoenix Valley. The founders are Walter and Marti. They are from Bergamo, in the North of the Italy. They attended the Gelato University Carpigiani and then opened one of the first Gelato Shop in Arizona. Fabrizio, the new owner, born in Sicily but he lived in Milan most of the "Italian life". He owned a restaurant in Italy and provided a lot of consultancy to restaurant businesses in Italy and here in US. Everyone is committed to provide the best Italian food experience to all our customers. First of all we provide only authentic Italian food and using only fresh and local ingredients without addictive. We made our gelato daily in our store.

az-doughbird.description: Doughbird brings you a crave-worthy menu with an unexpected yet perfect duo: Pizza & Rotisserie. Yep, you heard right...Pizza and Rotisserie. Now, eat the best of both worlds with the tastiest house-made pizza and rotisserie chicken in Phoenix. A neighborhood spot where you can get comfortable with eclectic combinations like our Brussels Sprout Pizza adorned with melted sweet potato and glazed bacon or our juicy Rotisserie Chicken in a rich Thai curry coconut broth. With any of our eight house-made sauces, dunking your pizza crust will be taken to a whole new level. At Doughbird, you'll discover a new irresistible favorite. So, savor a fun family dinner any night of the week, or grab a slice & sip on a cocktail at happy hour daily, but always add a bite of interesting to your day.

az-dragon-wok-fine-chinese.description: Dragon Wok Fine Chinese Restaurant, located in the heart of Gilbert, Arizona, is far more than your typical neighborhood takeout spot. Since opening in 2005 at the corner of Ray and Cooper Roads, it has built a reputation as one of the "Top 100 Chinese Restaurants in the USA," blending traditional Cantonese roots with an upscale, inviting atmosphere. Founded by Chef Sam Szeto, the son of a grand master chef from Canton, Dragon Wok was created with a mission to change the perception of Chinese-American food. Every dish is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, ensuring the "wok hei" (breath of the wok) is present in every bite.

az-eddie-vs-prime-seafood.description: Eddie V’s charismatic vibe draws you in and holds you close, invites you to be seen, or sit back and just savor. The finest seafood and steaks. World-class wine and service. And live jazz in the V Lounge. Excellence: Our Key Ingredient Seafood is what we’re known for, but our specialty is excellence. Fish arrive daily from pristine waters around the world including Swordfish from Block Island, Scallops from Georges Banks, and Yellow Fin Tuna from the Caribbean. USDA Prime steaks are hand cut and specially aged for over 28 days to ensure peak flavor. Devotion to excellence is the guiding principal in all that we do. From making fresh tortillas by hand daily for our lobster tacos to including a full half pound of Jumbo Lump crab meat in our crab cakes, we strive to go above and beyond in every step of preparation. Our intent: to prepare the finest meal you’ve ever had.
