az-eden-rooftop-bar.description: We’re not your typical rooftop bar. We believe you deserve a little bit more. So whether you join us for lunch overlooking downtown Phoenix by day or sultry cocktails by night, we’re here for you – with something just a bit unexpected. Morning sunshine gives way to fiery sunsets and twinkling city lights, while our team crafts moments of connection through exceptional service. Eden Bar began with a vision to create something extraordinary – a sanctuary where sophisticated cocktails and Mediterranean cuisine could be savored against the backdrop of mountain sunsets and city lights. Drawing inspiration from the Verde River's vibrant palette and the desert's subtle beauty, we've crafted a space where connections flourish and memories are made, one exquisite moment at a time.

az-electric-pickle.description: Electric Pickle is where the thrill of pickleball and outdoor entertainment meets globally inspired cuisine in an elevated ambiance. This “eatertainment” destination blends the fast-paced action of the nation’s fastest-growing sport with a vibrant social atmosphere, featuring state-of-the-art, high-tech pickleball courts, private cabanas, Full Swing Golf Simulators, bocce ball, cozy fire pits, a live-music stage and a lawn for cornhole, lounging and so much more. After serving up some competition, grab a table at the expansive, two-story restaurant that effortlessly integrates indoor and outdoor spaces. Bold flavors and inventive cocktails await, setting the stage for the perfect post-game celebration.

Drawing inspiration from different regions across the country, the menu is a modest representation of the diverse culinary landscape, capturing feisty favourites like Puchka on the streets of Bengal reimagined with Mint jaljeera, blackberry kala khatta and pineapple passionfruit water; to the Tandoori stuffed bread Kulcha inspired from the streets of Amritsar made with cottage cheese and paired with baby heirloom tomato chutney and pickled gooseberries; to the Kerala Quilon chicken, served with Peanut chutney, avocado mousse pachadi and moringa. The menu also showcases some of the signature Indian kebabs cooked on Robata stones and presented in an eclectic way.

az-flint-by-baltaire.description: FLINT by Baltaire is a wood-fired contemporary American restaurant in Phoenix, bringing together coastal Mediterranean influences and bold Middle Eastern flavors in the heart of the Biltmore area. Located at 24th Street and Camelback Road, FLINT offers lunch, dinner, rooftop cocktails, private dining, and catering in a striking two-story setting. At the heart of the menu is the wood-fired grill, where premium meats, seafood, vegetables, and Mediterranean-inspired dishes take on the unmistakable flavor of live fire. Fresh ingredients, vibrant spices, and bold flavors come together across a menu designed for everything from a weekday power lunch to dinner and drinks. The restaurant’s elegant dining room and lounge feature mid-century modern-inspired furnishings, dramatic chandelier lighting, and floor-to-ceiling foldaway glass walls that open onto a year-round outdoor dining patio. Upstairs at FLINT offers a rooftop cocktail experience overlooking Camelback Road, making it an ideal destination for sunset drinks, date nights, celebrations, and evenings out in Phoenix. Whether you’re joining us for lunch, gathering for dinner, planning a private event, or heading upstairs for rooftop cocktails, FLINT by Baltaire brings wood-fired cooking, warm hospitality, and a distinctly Phoenix energy to the table.

az-george-gather.description: At George & Gather, we believe food should nourish the body, spark connection, and bring joy to every bite. We’re all about feel-good food; crafted with uncompromising quality, made from trusted ingredients, and deeply rooted in our community. G&G delivers a dynamic, all-day experience with counter-service breakfast and full-service lunch and dinner. Guests can relax in our vibrant indoor dining room or gather on the spacious covered patio, discover our dedicated market, and shop locally sourced merchandise. Our indoor-outdoor bar pours seasonal craft cocktails, elevated mocktails, curated wines, and local beer, making G&G the ultimate gathering place. Our scratch kitchen is built on a simple philosophy: real food made with real ingredients. We’ve eliminated processed foods and seed oils to make way for organic produce, nourishing whole foods, and bold, craveable flavors. Every dish is thoughtfully prepared, and every sip from our scratch bar is handcrafted, from fresh-pressed juices to house-infused spirits and locally roasted coffee. Because when you eat well, you feel good. And when you feel good, you can take on the world. So pull up a seat, stay awhile, and let us take care of the rest. By George, let’s gather!

az-kauboi.description: KAUBOI Scottsdale is a bold, high-energy Japanese steakhouse located inside The REMI Hotel in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale. Where fire meets finesse, KAUBOI brings together premium steaks, craveable sushi, robata-grilled specialties, craft cocktails, and a thoughtfully curated selection of Japanese whiskies in an electrifying atmosphere. The Japanese-inspired menu takes guests on a culinary journey built around premium ingredients and inventive technique. Experience expertly crafted sushi, open-flame robata cooking, premium cuts from the grill, and shareable dishes designed for the table, all complemented by a distinctive cocktail and Japanese whiskey program. Striking design and high-energy surroundings make KAUBOI a destination for everything from intimate dinners and date nights to celebrations, group dining, and nights out in Old Town Scottsdale. For those searching for a Japanese steakhouse or sushi in Scottsdale, KAUBOI offers a fresh take on the experience, bringing steak, sushi, spirits, and standout hospitality together under one roof. Fire meets finesse at KAUBOI.

az-lings-wok-shop.description: Ling's Wok Shop is the latest innovation from the team behind the popular Ling & Louie's Asian Bar and Grill. This new and dynamic concept combines modern Asian cuisine with the best of both counter-service and full-service dining. Operating as a fast-casual restaurant during lunch - when guests are always on the go - Ling's Wok Shop provides fast, consistent and delicious menu options that are both healthy and convenient. During happy hour and dinner service - when our guests want to relax and unwind - we operate as a full-service restaurant, providing friendly and knowledgeable service as well as a full bar of hand-crafted cocktails, expertly selected wines, and local beers. At Ling's Wok Shop, it's all about the wok! Our wok-centered kitchen ensures that the food is fresh, clean, and healthy. We have modernized wok cooking to maintain the integrity of our premium ingredients and to keep the freshness and snap of the veggies. Our chef-crafted sauces are uniquely created to enhance the flavors of each dish, ensuring each bite will have you craving more!

az-lons-at-the-hermosa.description: LON's at the Hermosa Inn, Paradise Valley's top-ranked restaurant and one of People Magazine and OpenTable's 50 Most Beautiful Restaurants in America, offers a dining experience as rich in atmosphere as it is in flavor. Set within the original 1930s adobe home and studio of cowboy artist Lon Megargee, the restaurant is a place where history is felt in every hand-hewn beam and ironwork detail. Executive Chef Brian Peterson crafts a globally inspired menu rooted in the Arizona landscape — roasted, smoked, and wood-grilled dishes built from the freshest regional ingredients. Inside, the intimate dining room and lounge adorned with Megargee's artwork create the kind of atmosphere that makes a meal feel like an event. And when the evenings cool, the expansive patio offers views of Camelback Mountain framed by a trickling fountain. Whether you're celebrating something special or simply making an ordinary evening anything but, LON's delivers the kind of meal, and setting, worth lingering over.

az-marcellino-ristorante.description: The secrets of authentic Italian cuisine are proudly showcased by the man who creates the most innovative dishes this side of heaven. Let Chef Marcellino mesmerize your palate any night of the week with hand-crafted, naturally flavored pastas [saffron, squid ink, cacio e pepe, etc.]; heaps of crustaceans; wild game; reduction sauces; seasonal truffles and more. Seeking simplicity? Scialatielli alle Vongole. Comfort food? Gnocchi so light and sumptuous they'll make you sigh. Decadence? Porcini-infused Fettuccine, sautéed with generous amounts of lobster, shitake mushrooms and a white truffle drizzle. Vegetarian: Fettucine Contadina with a dollop of ricotta. Vegan and no-gluten options available; please allow extra preparation time or provide advance notice if possible. Celebrate your next occasion with us, and share the delicious, old-World elegance of a Marcellino experience with your family & friends!

az-melting-pot-restaurant-of-ahwatukee.description: If you are looking for one the finest restaurants in the Ahwatukee Foothills area, look no further than the fondue experience of a lifetime at The Melting Pot! Choose from 2, 3 or more mouthwatering courses to complete your romantically fun dining experience. You can even pair your experience with an Arizona craft beer or local wine selection too! We start by melting cheeses, seasonings and other secret ingredients right before your eyes! We then follow that delectable course with a light dinner salad to change up your feasting palate before the main course is presented. The fondue effect then continues on to entrée to fit everyone’s exclusive preferences. Whether you are a Steak Lover, a Seafood Trio fan, Vegetarian fanatic or even a Gluten-Free diner; we have a plate that will surely satisfy you! Last but definitely not least (sometimes it even comes first!), we have chocolate fondue. With an entire menu devoted to these little morsels of heaven, your chocolate decision might be the hardest one you’ve ever had to make. Although it technically has a Phoenix address, this unique Melting Pot location is found in the heart of the township of Ahwatukee. Just drive a couple of miles west of the I-10 on Ray Road, and you will find yourself at one of the tastiest and most romantic restaurants around! There is even a ballroom dancing school right next door, what a perfect idea for an incredible date! What most people don’t realize is that this location is one of the closest ones to the East Valley! Chandler, Gilbert and Queen Creek, that means you!

az-melting-pot-restaurant-of-arrowhead.description: If you’ve never dined fondue-style before, then The Melting Pot is truly a great first choice! The combination of a warm atmosphere, ambient lighting and outstanding cuisine make the Arrowhead location an impeccable restaurant for any special occasion; even a casual night out on the town! You begin with the decision of choosing two, three, or more courses to enjoy. The options are endless! Literally, we have menus that offer endless fondue! We prefer to start by melting blends of cheeses while you try not to drool on the table, and then follow with a delicious salad. For the main event, you’ll simmer tantalizing meats, flavorsome shrimp or lobster, all accompanied by appetizing vegetables and sauces. As far as chocolate goes, that’s an entirely different story. Are you a Flaming Turtle fan? Or how about a S’mores admirer? With over eight different options, you will find it tough to choose only one! Pair any course with an Arizona craft beer or local wine selection too! Our Glendale restaurant is located in Arrowhead on 59th Ave just south of the 101 in the NW corner of the Citadelle Plaza. Feel free to stop by after a long day of shopping at the Arrowhead Mall. We guarantee a fresh handmade cocktail or an excellent wine will take the stress away! Whether you are celebrating a ten year anniversary, or simply celebrating Friday night, The Melting Pot is known as a dinner to dine for.

az-minnow.description: Minnow is a casual sushi spot in Arcadia, Phoenix built for how we actually like to eat and drink—easygoing, high-quality, and a little fun. We’re the kind of place you can stop into for a morning matcha, come back for lunch, swing by for happy hour, or settle in for dinner and cocktails. Order at the counter, grab a seat, and let us take it from there. No white tablecloths, no fuss—just really good food and drinks in a space that feels welcoming and relaxed. Our menu is centered around fresh sushi, craveable small plates, and a thoughtful matcha program, alongside craft cocktails, beer, and wine. Everything is designed to be approachable, affordable, and consistently great—whether you’re popping in solo, meeting friends, or bringing the whole neighborhood crew. Minnow was made for the Arcadia community. We love the mix of early mornings, active afternoons, and laid-back nights that define this part of Phoenix, and our space reflects that rhythm. You’ll find people grabbing matcha after a workout, lingering over lunch, or easing into the evening during happy hour before dinner. At the end of the day, Minnow is about good energy, good ingredients, and a place you actually want to come back to—again and again.

az-patricias-pizza.description: As the daughter of famed Restauranter Tomaso Maggiore, Melissa Maggiore traveled extensively to Italy with her father, where her love affair with food and wine began. After pursuing a journalism degree at Arizona State University, she decided her passion for food, wine, and hospitality could not be ignored and returned to San Diego to assist in the opening of a new family restaurant venture in Coronado. Through the years Melissa developed her skills and knowledge of restaurants from her mentor and father. In 1997, Melissa opened the trattoria, La Bruschetta, in La Jolla, California, and embarked on a second location, Zibibbo Italian Bistro, in Encinitas, California in 2000. On May 5, 2010 Melissa opened Tommy V’s Urban Kitchen in Carlsbad, California, the subject of Food Network primetime series, Family Style. In 2018 Melissa and her husband Kevin relocated to Scottsdale to be closer to family and assist in the family operations. In 2021 Melissa opened, The Italian Daughter, an homage to her late father. In 2024 Melissa was recognized by NIAF, the National Italian American Foundation for her contributions to the Italian culinary scene. In 2025 Melissa opened Patricia’s Pizza, honoring her mother Patricia’s legacy, named after her parent’s first restaurant in Garnerville, New York in 1969.

az-pinyon.description: At Pinyon, our story begins with a walk through a quiet coastal village along the Mediterranean. We came across a solitary pinyon pine—not the tallest or most striking tree, but one that seemed to belong so completely to the landscape it felt almost sacred. The villagers spoke of its resilience, and of the extraordinary pine nuts it produced—tiny treasures that had nourished families for generations. These pine nuts weren’t just food; they carried tradition, connection, and a kind of magic. That spirit stayed with us. Inspired by travels across Spain, Italy, Greece, Turkey, France, Malta, and Morocco, we created Pinyon to celebrate the Mediterranean’s vibrant food culture—timeless recipes, coastal traditions, and the simple beauty and joy of sharing a meal.

az-pistoleros-parrilla.description: Fire, Flavor, and Family—A Mexican Steakhouse in Old Town Scottsdale Founded by brothers Luke and Jake Kory, Pistoleros Parrilla was born from the flavors and traditions of Nogales, Mexico. Luke grew up alongside Marco Garcia, and years later, after Marco became a chef, the two reunited with a shared goal: to bring Scottsdale a true taste of Sonoran cooking and the borderland spirit that shaped them. Our kitchen is fueled by live wood-burning fire and rooted in generations of shared tradition. From mesquite-grilled meats to bold, honest ingredients, every dish reflects the soul of Northern Mexico Simple, soulful, and meant to be shared around the table. Where mesquite smoke, tequila, and hospitality meet, Pistoleros Parrilla brings the grit of the borderlands and the warmth of Mexican tradition to Old Town Scottsdale.

az-sexy-roman.description: Sexy Roman is where a big night officially begins: bold, buzzing, and built for unforgettable moments. Led by James Beard-nominated Chef Jason Franey, Chef Tom Castaneda and the LA-based restaurant team behind Baltaire Steakhouse and FLINT by Baltaire, Sexy Roman brings a seductive, modern take on Italian dining to the heart of Old Town Scottsdale. The menu pairs thoughtful interpretations of Italian classics with elevated takes on Roman street food, from fresh pasta made in-house daily to indulgent dishes designed for sharing. Roaming Martini Carts bring ice-cold cocktails tableside, while a lively bar program keeps the energy flowing throughout the night. Set within W Scottsdale, Sexy Roman surrounds guests in a lavish, dramatic setting where warm red lighting, music and a high-energy atmosphere make dinner feel like the beginning of something bigger. Come for fresh pasta and martinis, stay as the room comes alive. It's la dolce vita, turned all the way up.

az-the-arrogant-butcher.description: Already an iconic downtown Phoenix landmark, the restaurant and bar at The Arrogant Butcher is one of the only places where sports fans and theater-goers can enjoy a burger and a beer next to some of Arizona’s top politicians. Behind the drawn curtains of the three private dining rooms, one may find bachelorettes toasting former freedoms, important legislation being discussed, or pre-concert parties warming up for the night’s big event. The Arrogant Butcher offers you the best of everything – seafood, steaks, draft beer, wine and cocktails, comfort food and good company. So if you’re looking for downtown’s only place to be seen, look no further than the corner of Jefferson and 1st. Look no further than the Arrogant Butcher.

az-the-italian-daughter.description: The Italian Daughter will feature live piano music by local musicians nightly-- expect familiar songs by Billy Joel and Frank Sinatra, the classics, and top hits throughout the decades for dine-in entertainment. The new age meets classic Italian decor in the restaurant’s quaint and cozy atmosphere. In continuation of The Maggiore Group’s dedication to bringing Italy’s world-renowned cuisine to Arizona, The Italian Daughter will spotlight some of the best dishes of the family’s home country. The restaurant’s menu is made from-scratch and will offer more variety in The Maggiore Group’s already-expansive selection of Italian entrees elevated Italian cuisine featuring handcrafted pastas, craft charcuterie boards, Neapolitan pizzas, and desserts from the group’s other Italian concepts-- Tomaso’s, The Sicilian Butcher and The Sicilian Baker. The cocktail menu will feature Italian-inspired craft cocktails, gelato martinis as well as a curated selection of wines and beers. Takeout options will be available including to-go family meal packs, a-la-carte menu items and delivery. “The Italian Daughter is a restaurant concept that I believe my father would have been really excited to see,” Maggiore Meyer says in a press release of her late father, who died in January. “I want people to experience the joys of our authentic Italian cuisine in an atmosphere full of music and energy.”

az-the-mexicano-phoenix.description: The Mexicano will feature a build-your-own Michelada bar — touted as the first restaurant in the country to have one — an in-restaurant DJ, and a large bar, 5,000-square-foot dining room, and outdoor patio. Staying true to his over-the-top creations, such as the Banana Split Brioche French Toast at Hash or the foot-long cannoli at Sicilian Baker, The Mexicano will have its own signature flares, like a 50-ounce margarita, a piñata margarita that is served in a personal-sized piñata that people can take home, a three-foot quesadilla, and lava rock fajitas served on a hot lava stone. Street tacos, tamales, pineapple guacamole, shrimp cocktail, and various meats and seafood dishes, as well as desserts, such as churros and flan, are also on the menu. The michelada bar will have some 40 toppings to choose from, such as oysters, shrimp cocktail, pickled jicama, dry chorizo, and tamarindo sticks.

az-the-sicilian-butcher-chandler.description: Choose-your-own-meatball and build-your-own charcuterie board experience complete with hand-rolled meatballs and saucy attitude, fresh-made pastas and Italian butcher-style meats. WITH CASUAL DINE-IN AND TO-GO SERVICES, THE SICILIAN BUTCHER IS CENTERED UPON A BUILD-YOUR-OWN MEAL EXPERIENCE WITH GOURMET MEATBALLS AND ITALIAN-CURED MEATS FOR CHARCUTERIE BOARDS. USING FAMILY RECIPES, THE SICILIAN BUTCHER INTRODUCES 15 CRAFT MEATBALL VARIETIES INCLUDING DRY-AGED STEAK, LAMB, AHI TUNA, LUMP CRAB, AND TOMASO’S SICILIAN VERSION MADE WITH GROUND VEAL, PRIME BEEF, PORK, PINE NUTS, RAISINS, AND PECORINO CHEESE, AND MEATLESS/VEGETARIAN CHOICES SUCH AS LENTIL AND EGGPLANT PARMIGIANA. THE CHOOSE-YOUR-OWN-MEATBALL ADVENTURE CONTINUES WITH EIGHT SAUCE OPTIONS SUCH AS GARLIC-BASIL MARINARA, PESTO TRAPANESE, PARMIGIANO CREAM SAUCE, TRUFFLE MUSHROOM, AND SPICY ARRABBIATA AND GUESTS CAN MIX OR MATCH THEIR MEATBALLS WITH A CAESAR SALAD, HOUSE-EXTRUDED PASTA, BREAD FOR SANDWICHES, POLENTA OR RISOTTO.

az-the-stockyards.description: In 1947, The Stockyards, Arizona’s Original Steakhouse, opened its doors for the first time with a menu focused solely on its historical past: beef. Staying true to its heritage, The Stockyards’ menu continues to feature only the finest corn-fed, aged steaks and prime rib. With an emphasis on hearty flavors, The Stockyards' “New West Cuisine” embraces the culture and culinary trends of the Southwest, utilizing the freshest and highest quality indigenous ingredients in new and innovative ways. To date, The Stockyards remains a part of local history and a favorite gathering place for Arizonans.

az-urban-fraiche-restaurant.description: Urban Fraîche is a chef-driven, farm-to-table Mediterranean restaurant located in the heart of Phoenix, known for fresh, high-quality organic ingredients and vibrant flavors. We proudly serve wild-caught seafood, natural meats raised without antibiotics, and prepare every dish without seed oils or processed sugars. Our menu changes daily based on what’s fresh and available, ensuring a unique experience each time you visit. With live belly dancing entertainment and a warm, inviting ambiance that feels like a home away from home, Urban Fraîche offers a dining experience that’s truly like no other. We invite you to enjoy unforgettable cuisine, meaningful moments, and memories that last long after the meal is over.

az-elephante.description: Now open inside Scottsdale Fashion Square, Élephante is an all-new coastal Italian restaurant combining irresistible fare, delightful drinks and spectacular vibes. Handcrafted by the Los Angeles-based, Wish You Were Here restaurant group, every single aspect of this stunning dining destination inside has been bespoke built, from the furniture to the artwork to the imported travertine tile, all with the intention to transport guests to the sun-drenched Mediterranean. Starting with the menu of wood-fired pizzas and puccia bread, plus house-made pastas and sustainably-sourced seafood and meats, to the refreshing cocktails and the globe-spanning wine program, Élephante is a breezy escape from the everyday. Drawing inspiration from various southern Mediterranean regions, Élephante's menu showcases shareable, seasonal dishes, such as the signature puccia starter, a puffed, soft bread from Italy’s Puglia region, served with the whipped eggplant, or imported burrata, anchovies crudo and more. Plus, savor fresh pastas such as vodka sauce canestri and ricotta cavatelli, or wood-fired grill entrées including dry-aged bone-in ribeye, and lobster piccata, cooked whole and then split and drizzled with lemon-caper-butter sauce. But be sure to save room for desserts like the soft-serve-machine sundae selections, including a Sicilian olive oil with honey caramel. And because it’s not a vacation without a cocktail in hand, Élephante serves an extensive menu of signature cocktails, punch bowls, mocktails, and a curated selection of classics. Plus, Élephante’s famed wine program tempts with wine from every single region across Italy, including limited quantity vintage wines from top producers, and four proprietary private labels, including a Pinot Grigio from Sicily and Super Tuscan from Tuscany.

items.name: Kung Pao Chicken (shareable size)
items.description: 宫保鸡丁 A classic with imperial roots — named after Baozhen Ding, a Qing dynasty governor known as “Gong Bao.” What began as a tribute dish in Sichuan became a worldwide favorite, blending tender chicken, crunchy peanuts, and a perfect sweet-spicy glaze.

items.name: General Tso's Chicken (shareable size))
items.description: 左宗鸡 A dish every American seems to know — named after General Tso of the Qing dynasty, though he never tasted it. Born in American Chinese restaurants, it’s saucy, sweet, and just the right amount of spicy — a bold remix of Chinese flavors made to win hearts abroad.

items.name: Broccoli Beef (shareable size)
items.description: 芥兰牛 An American-born classic inspired by Cantonese stir-fries. In China, it’s usually made with Chinese gai lan, but here, broccoli took the spotlight — a symbol of adaptation that turned into a beloved staple in Chinese takeout culture.

items.name: Dry Pot Beef (shareable size)
items.description: 干锅牛 From the bustling streets of Sichuan, this dish is the louder cousin of hot pot — but without the broth. Sizzling beef, chili, garlic, and spices come together in a heavy wok, meant to stay hot at the table and shared among friends with cold drinks and loud laughter.

items.name: Chicken Chow Mein
